tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ lha min ston mchog zla med thub dbang dang*/ / bstan 'dzin rig gnas kun shes mkhas rnams dang*/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas gus btud nas/ /rig gnas kun shes rnam bshad 'dir brjod bya/ / 'dir mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo'i gtso bo ni rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes bya ste/ rgyal tshab dam pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes gzung dang*/ /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed// ces chos tshol gyi skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga po 'di don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su nges par btsal dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang sgra rig pas ni tshig la dang*/ gtan tshigs rig pas ni don la log par rtog pa tshar bcod dgos shing*/ bzo rig pas ni 'dod dgu spyi dang*/ gso ba rig pas ni khyad par nad med don du gnyer ba rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ nang rig pas ni bdag nyid de kho na nyid dang lam zab rgyas kun shes nas nyams su blangs dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dir bshad pa la sbyor dngos 'jug go /dang po la mchod par brjod| bshad pa dam bca'/ mnyan par gdams pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rjod byed bar gyi zung ldan bar ma chod kyi sgra rgyan du byas la/ brjod bya rgyu tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs/ ngo bo don gnyis mthar son te rang don thogs med kyi mkhyen pa dang dmigs med kyi thugs rje/ gzhan don 'gro ba'i ma rig pa kun bcom pa'i 'phrin las rnams nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod pa'i don rgyan gyi gtso bo yang tshang ngo*/ / gnyis pa ni/ rtsom pa mthar phyin zhing gzhan la phan pa'i ched du ston pa la gus pas btud nas/ gzhung rtsom par zhe nas khas blangs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mchog nyan rang gi dgra bcom pas kyang rang lam de tsam gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub mi srid pas/

don gnyis mthar phyin 'dod na 'di la mi 'bad pa'i thabs med ces nan gyis bskul ba'o| |dngos gzhi la spyir bstan/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dgos pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ brjod bya'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ thun mong dang de min gyi rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ don gnyer sogs te/ go rim 'dir bstan pa'i rig gnas dang po gnyis kyis don gnyer spyi dang khyad par rjes su 'dzin la/ bar pa gnyis kyis tshig dang don la log par smra ba tshar gcod cing*/ phyi rol pa dang thun mong min pa'i grol lam lhag par ston pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi sgos chos yin pas nang rig ste/ de la yang gdul bya thun mong ba la mdo phyogs sde snod gsum dang/ thun mong ma yin pa la sngags phyogs rgyud sde bzhi rnams ni 'dir bshad par bya ba'i brjod bya mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lnga po re re'ang brjod bya'i lus bsdus na gsum gsum nyid du gnas pa'i bzo ni/ spyir yid kyi rtogs nas lus ngag la 'jug par khyad med kyang*/ yid dang 'brel ba'i lus kyi g.yo ba dang ngag gi brjod pa gtso bor gyur pas lus ngag gi bzo gnyis dang*/ ma 'brel bar yid kyi bsam pa tsam gyi dbang du byas pa yid bzo'o/ /gso rig la gso bya nad dang nad pa/ gso thabs sman dang dpyad/ gso ba po nad g.yog dang sman pa'o/ /yan lag brgyad par sman dang nad pa dang*/ nag g.yog dang sman pa ste bzhi la skyon bzhi bzhi spangs pa'i yon tan bzhi bzhi ldan pa ste/ bzhir bshad mod nad g.yog dang sman pa gnyis ka gso ba por 'dir bsdus so/ /sgra la dpang los/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'og nas ston no/ /tshad ma la brjod bya/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun byin ngag /ltar snang bcas pa gzhan rtogs byed/

/ces mngon sum dang rjes dpag yang dag dang ltar snang sgrub ngag dang thal 'gyur yang dag dang ltar snang ste rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad du grags shing*| rang don dang gzhan don gnyis su'ang 'dus la/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi phyogs sngar/ rtog ge'i tshig don bcu drug tu yang gsungs mod kyi/ gnas gsum gzhal bya gtan 'bebs su rgya cher gsungs pa ltar byas so/ /nang rig ni theg pa gsum du grags shing*/ grags pa ltar don la'ang grub la/ de yang brjod bya'i dbang du byas na nyan thos kyi/ rang sangs rgyas kyi/ byang sems kyi theg pa rnams te phyi ma la theg chen zhes brjod do/ /brjod byed kyi dbang du byas na theg pa thun mong ba 'dul lung sde bzhi lta bu dang*/ thun mong min pa la mdo phyogs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dang*/ sngags phyogs rgyud sde rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /gsum pa la rig gnas thun mong ba'i dang*/ thun mong min pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la dngos dang rtsod spang ngo/ /dang po ni/ rig gnas dang po bzhi la thun mong ba zhes nges par brjod dgos te/ bzhi ka'i brjod bya gsum tshan thams cad kyang nang par ma zad phyi rol pa la'ang tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/ des na mkhas pa rnams la ni de ltar du grags so/ /gnyis pa la rtsod pa spyir spang ba dang*/ bzhi pa'i gzhung la spang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ mkhas rlom kha cig na re/ gal te phyi rol pa'i rig gnas bzhi po ston pa'i brjod bya sogs/ zhe na/ phyi pa'i gzhung la skyon can 'ba' zhig gis ma khyab ste/ gzhon nu karti kas bshad pa'i sgra ka lā pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa mu stegs kyi mkhas pa jo bo drag 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i slob phan la skyon can gyi gtan tshig ma grub pa'i phyir te/ sgra rig ston pa'i legs bshad du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod| |ces pa ltar/ rang rang gi gzhung lugs la mkhas pa gong ma gong ma'i rig pas 'og ma la cung zad gnod pa tsam gyis thun mong ba zhes bya bar mi rigs na ni/

rang sde bye mdo sems tsam ste dngos smra sde gsum po nang pa sangs rgyas par gcig pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung*| sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa ni/ bod kyi rje btsun gong ma rnams kyang gtan tshigs rig pa yin gyi/ nang rig ma yin pas sgra tshad la chos 'brel du mi bzhed de/ /'o skol gyi ston pas phyi pa'i drang srong ring 'phur skyes dang lhag spyod la bsam gtan gzugs med gyi man ngag gsan pa bzhin no/ /zhes bzhed la/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis kyang chos 'byung du rig gnas thun mong bar bgrangs so| |phyis chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs ni/ mngon 'du'i phyir dang yang yang dang*| |zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi pa tshang bas mngon par bzhed cing*/ dpang lo yab sras kyis lung gi mngon pa dang*| rig pa'i mngon pa zhes gnyis su bya ba'i phyi ma'i mtshan gzhir mdzad la/ bstan 'dzin chen po tsong kha pas kyang*/ byang phyogs 'di na tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la/ /sbyangs dang ma sbyangs du ma mgrin gcig tu/ /mdo dang sde bdun kun na byang chub tu/ /bgrod pa'i go skabs rim pa yod min zer/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis phyogs kyi glang po la/ /dngos su 'di rtsoms 'di ni ma 'ongs dus| |'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes/ /gsung gi snang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin/ /'di ni mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ /mthong nas tshul der legs par dpyad pa na/ /zhes sogs kyi 'gal 'du 'dzin mod kyi/ de ni sgra rig la'ang 'di ltar mtshungs te/ byang phyogs 'di na sgra yi gzhung lugs la/ / sbyangs dang ma sbyangs du ma mgrin gcig tu/ /ka lā tsand+ra kun na byang chub tu/ / bgrod pa'i go skabs rim pa yod min zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi tsand+ra go mi la| |dngos su 'di rtsoms 'di ni ma 'ongs dus/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes/

/gsung gi snang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin/ /'di yang mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ 'gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni slob dpon tsand+ra go mis sgra mdo tsand+ra pa brtsams zin pa na/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgra kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba rjod byed tshigs bcad byas shing brjod bya mchog tu 'gyur pa zhig mdzad nas grwa 'gṛm du byung bas/ rang gi bstan bcos mi legs par gzigs nas thugs phyung ste khron par bskyur ba na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis khyod rang gi 'di ma 'ongs pa na 'gro phan che bas khron pa nas thon cig ces dngos su bka' bstsal nas bton pas chus cung zad kyang ma nyams par thon zhing khron pa de la tsand+ra khron pa zhes grags nas chu 'thungs tshad blo rno bar 'gyur to zhes gsal bar grags so/ /mngon par 'jog pa'i chos bzhi'i yang yang dang zil gnon tshang du chug kyang*/ chos nyid mngon sum du byed tshul dang*| lam mngon par rtogs tshul ma tshang ste/ tshogs sbyor sogs lam gyi rnam gzhag cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag med kyi gzhi gtan 'bebs cung zad yod kyang*/ mchod brjod kyi 'phros don tsam yin pas/ bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin zhing de yang mngon du byed thabs kyi bsgom rim mngon pa lta bu cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nang pa la rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung med par 'gyur ba dang*/ gsung rab spyi'i don gyi dgongs 'grel yin pa tsam gyis nang rig tu 'jog na sgra rig skyon du 'jug pa dang*/ mdo'i mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan nang rig dang mthun pa tsam gyis der 'jog na/ sman yan lag brgyad pa'i mchod brjod du/ 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs pa yi nad/ /rgyun du 'brel bas lus kun khyab 'gyur pa/ /'dod dang khro ba gti mug sel mdzad pa'i/ /sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang*/ tsand+ra par| grub pa kun mkhyen kun la phan/

/thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal na sa| |nyung du rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid bshad par bya| |zhes dang sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su/ nang gi mtshan mo bshes bral gyi/ /nang gi thub pa nyi ma ni/ /snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can/ /rgyal ba nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang*/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod kyi mchod brjod ni| de dag las kyang nang gi gnyen por shin tu gsal ba rnams/ chos grags lta bus rgyas par bshad na/ nang rig dang shin tu mthun pa 'byung mod/ de dag nang rig tu 'dod na ha cang thal lo/ /des na dngos bstan dang de yang bstan bya'i gtso bo'i sgo nas thun mong rig gnas su gzung dgos te/ gzhal bya'i gnas gsum dang rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad po dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor nges pa'i phyir ro/ khyab ste/ drang don dang nges don gyi mdo dang*/ mdo phyogs sde snod gsum dang sngags phyogs la rgyud sde bzhir 'byed pa sogs kyang dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bos 'byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ thun mong pa la bstan bya'i gtso bor med pa'i 'khor ba'i rtse mo srid rtse las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa sogs bstan bya'i gtso bor rtsal 'don gang du mdzad pa'i gsung rab de ni nang rig nyid du rgyu mtshan du mas legs par grub bo zhes blo'i nor can rnams kyi rtogs par bya'o/ /le'u dang po cung zad bshad pa'o// // so sor bshad pa la lnga las/ dang po bzo rig bshad pa la/ bzo rig la gus pas 'jug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jug bya bzo rig gi rang bzhin/ 'dir ma spros pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la sgrub pa nyams len gyi 'khor lo dang bsod nams mnyam/ 'dod rgu mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas mchog tu bstan/ des na bzo rig la mi gus pa gcer bu'i grub mtha' yin pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rig gnas dang po sogs te/ sngon gyi chos rgyal bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po sogs dang*/

mnyan yod kyi khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang*/ ko'u sham bhi'i khyim bdag gdangs can la sogs pa shin tu mang po dang*| phyis kyi chos rgyal mya ngan med dang*/ bod kyi chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum la sogs pa/ bstan pa'i sby-in bdag dang bdag rkyen mdzad pa'i rgyal po dang khyim bdag ni/ bstan 'dzin gyi paṇa grub las kyang grangs mang ba 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las lung bstan pa rnams ni/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang kun dga' ra ba sogs bzhengs nas zhabs tog mdzad pa'i cha nas lung bstan pa yin gyi/ rgyal po de dag mkhas pa dang grub pa'i cha nas ma yin la/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang*/ /mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*/ /glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang*/ /yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ni/ /rdzas las 'byung ba'i bsod nams bdun| |zhes pa'i dang po gsum dang*/ bzhi yis tshangs pa'i bsod nams yin| |zhes pa'i dang po gnyis/ dge 'dun dbye ba bsdum pa dang*/ nyams len gyi gtso bo byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang bsod nams mnyam par gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bstan pa'i bdag rkyen chen po de dag dgyes pa skyed cing rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni rig gnas 'di nyid do| |de phyir dang po gnyis po don gnyer la/ /zhes sogs smras so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chu chen sogs te/ phyi'i rgya mtsho nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu len pa'i gru gzings chen po dang*/ gzhan yang chu bo bzhi dang bod kyi gtsang po sogs brgal ba'i gru chung gi bar dang*/ gzhan phyogs 'joms pa la/ thang rdzong bshig pa'i rdo'i 'phrul 'khor te rgyaugs su grags pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ chu rdzong 'joms pa gru'i/ ri rdzong 'joms pa me'i/ ral gri 'khor ba gri gug gi rtse mo 'byed pa rlung gi rtsig pa 'jig pa gur gyi/ go cha 'jig pa lcags mda'i 'phru' 'khor rnams dang*/ rang phyogs bsrung ba la pho brang bsrung ba ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor|

rgyal rigs 'thab pa shing rta'i tshad/ de bzhin du bde bar spyod pa'i 'phrul 'khor la/ ltad mo la 'gro ba'i don du khang bzang gi mtshan nyid/ dpyid kyi dga' ston gyi don du khyogs kyi mtshan nyid/ sdum ra bcu ba'i don du chu gyen du 'dren pa'i 'phrul 'khor rnams dus 'khor du gsungs la/ gzhan yang bza' btung rgyan gos sogs kyi nyer mkho'i dgos dgu thams cad rig gnas 'di la ma brten par mi 'grub pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ des na tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*/ /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi nges pas/ /ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar mdzod/ ces jo bo chen pos gsungs pa dang*/ gzhi gcig tu yun ma ring*/ gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi'i rtsom pa ma byed ces sogs ni/ rang sems kho na 'dul ba rtsal du 'don pa'i las dang po pa la dgongs mod kyi/ gcer bu kun dga' ra ba sogs/ rtsig pa sdig pa'i rgyu ru smra/ zhes srog chags phra mo la 'phral du gnod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas phugs kyi phan yon ma mthong bar zad de/ de lta na/ lus kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis/ /mdud pa 'jig pa gcer bu 'tshal/ zhes zas gcod pa sogs kyi dka' thub kyang bya mi rung ste/ lus kyi srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong la gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lung de gnyis kyi 'phro las rim pa bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa khyod kyis ni/ /de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs/zhes dang*/ khyod ni sems kyi dka' thub kyis/ /

mdud pa 'jig par bzhed pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gzhan gyi lus sogs la 'phral du gnod pa cung zad srid kyang rang gzhan gyi phan pa'i rgyu dang*| khyad par bstan pa'i rgyun dang sems can la phan pa 'byung na de gnyis kyi spang blang ma log par bya'o/ / gnyis pa la/ bzo rig gi khungs btsal ba dang*/ de'i dbye ba rgya cher bstan pa dang*/ de rig gnas kun gyi lus su bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ bzo rig ston pas gsungs shing bstan 'dzin gyis bkral nas phyag len du mdzad par shes nas gus pa bskyed pa bya'o zhes pa ni/ rgyal bas 'dul ba lung gi gnas mal gzhir/ /zhes sogs/ tshigs bcad phyed dang bzhi'o/ / gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni thams cad la yid sngon du 'gro yang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus gtso bor byed pas lus bzo ste/ gar thig dbyangs gsum du grags pa'i dang po gnyis lta bu'o| |ngag gtso bor byed pas ngag bzo ste/ /gsum pa lta bu'o/ /lus ngag gtso bor mi byed par yid nyid kyis 'grub pas yid bzo ste/ bsam byung gi rig shes khyad par can lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ lus bzo la gtso phal gnyis kyi dang po la sku gsung thugs kyi rten no/ / dang po ni/ sku la zhes sogs te/ longs sku dang sprul sku'o/ /dang po ni/ dbu skra'i rtse mo nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal lnga/ de nas rting pa'i bar la zhal lnga ste zhal bcu po re re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum re ste bsdoms pas brgya nyer lnga'o/ /'di ni 'pho rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis po'i sa bon zad par spangs pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid la/ kun tu 'od dang rdo rje'i 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis su phye ba'i thun mong ma yin pa bem chos kyi sgrib pa yin pas/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dri mar gsungs pas phar phyin theg pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir de'i longs sku la ni sor tshad 'di tsam dang mi ldan pas mdo phyogs su dang*/

rgyud sde 'gar yang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' bzheng ba'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs shing*/ zhal re la rang sor bcu gnyis mar grags pas rang sor brgya dang brgyad du longs sprul khyad med du byas nas de gnyis kyi khyad par rgyan yod med kyi 'jog par grags la/ dus 'khor du zhal bcu par bshad pa zhabs mthil gyi dkyus bsnan nas bgrangs pa'o zhes de phyogs kyi mkhas rlom dag zer mod/ zhabs mthil ni zhal bcu po la mi the bar rang sor bcu bzhir gsal bar gsungs pa ma mthong bar zad do/ /des na brgya dang bcu gnyis sam brgya dang brgyad pa ni/ dus 'khor lugs kyi sprul sku'i phyag tshad rags par byed dgos so/ /byang sems gzhir byas la yang*/ phyag rdor dang zla bzang gnyis longs sprul du gsal bar gsungs shing*/ mi phal pa'i lus kyi srid tshad la sor brgyad cu gya bzhi las med pas des na phar phyin pa'i longs sku la sor brgya dang bcu gnyis par byas nas de'i bar gyi sor nyer brgyad po/ sa bcu gnyis kyis bgos pas sor gnyis re dang nas phyaid dang gsum re lhag tsam sa re la 'phel bar 'gyur ro| |zhes kyang don gyis thob bo/ /'o na dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ rgyal po zla bzang gi spangs rtogs 'chad pa na/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la/ stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu 'gags zin nas gnyis pa 'gog par bshad pa dang*/ 'dir phrag bcu gnyis po phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dri mar bshad pa 'gal lo zhe na| mi 'gal te/ der dbugs 'byung ba dang 'jug pa sum stong drug brgyas dman pa zhes gsungs pas 'pho rlung mngon gyur ba la dgongs shing*/ byang sems kyang phar phyin theg pa'i sa bcu pa'i byang sems yin pa la dgongs so/ / de la ni/ sa dang po rab dga' thob ma thag tu 'pho rlung mngon gyur ba stong brgyad brgya phrag gcig 'gags pa nas chos kyi sprin thob ma thag bcu 'gags/

sa de nyid mthar phyin phyin gyi bar la phrag gnyis 'gags nas phar phyin theg pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob mod kyi/ da dung 'pho ba'i bag chags bem chos phra mo stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis lus pa kun tu 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyis spong zhing bcu gnyis pa'i spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa na mthar thug gi longs sku 'thob bo/ /kun tu 'od la sogs pa bcu gcig sngags kyi byang 'phags kyi sar byed dgos mod kyang de la ni yun ring mi 'gor bas lus tshad che chung sogs gzhag par dka' yang*/ zhib tu sbyor na sor bcu gsum pa nas nyer lnga'i bar gyi bcu gsum po la bcu gnyis kyis bgos pas rtogs mod kyi 'di dag lag len du byed pa'ang dka' bas zhib par ma bshad do/ /de ltar na phar phyin theg pa'i longs sprul la'ang sor bzhi'i khyad du bya'o/ /dus 'khor lugs kyi sprul sku phyag tshad rags par bshad pa de yang ston pa shāka thub sogs mdo phyogs kyi mchog gi sprul sku'i dbang du byas kyi/ sngags kyi longs sprul la ni khyad par mi byed de/ rgyud du gsungs pa'i tshad nyid dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i phyag tshad du bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs chu lon mar grags pa ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi'i sku dri bzang kha dog legs pos byugs nas ras gtsang gsher ba bkab ste blangs pas byin rlabs kyis phyag g.yas g.yon sogs thad kar byon pa zhig la dper byas nas bris pa ste/ sku'i zheng shin tu rgyas shing mgul pa thung ba shin tu brjid pa zhig 'byung ste phyag tshad sbyar du med do/ /spyir sprul sku la bzo'i dang skye ba'i dang mchog gi sprul sku gsum gsungs pa'i dang po ni dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i don du dri za'i cha byad du sprul pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa ni 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du dang gzhan yang rgyal blon dang skyes pa bud med khye'u dang bu mo dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i rnam par sprul pa ste/

gang la gang 'dul lo/ / snga ma'ang 'di nyid yin mod kyang de phrin las khyad par ba yin pas/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes zur du mdzad do/ / gsum pa la thun mong ba byang chub chen po brnyes tshul dang*/ mya ngan 'das tshul sogs ston par mdzad pa shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ thun mong min pa rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang brten pa mtha' dag ste/ 'di dag longs skur 'dod pa'i mkhas rlom shin tu mang mod kyi/ gang la gang 'dul gyi mdog dbyibs shin tu tha dad pa spyir sprul sku'i mtshan nyid du rang rang gis khas blangs pa brjed pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor re re zhing sprul bshad mdzad pa ma go bar/ sprul sku la rab byung gi rnam pa can gyis khyab par bzung bas nongs so/ /brten pa lha rnams sprul sku yin du chug kyang rten gzhal yas khang ni bem po'i rnam par snang bas sprul skur mi rung ngo zhe na/ khyed rang gis gzings dang zam pa la sogs pa skye ba'i sprul sku'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa'ang mtshungs so/ /de dag ni bem por snang ba tsam yin gyi ngo bo ni sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes kyi cha shas yin no zhe na 'dir yang de bzhin no/ /de ltar na mchog gi sprul sku thun mong ba ni bde gshegs brgyad mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa shin tu zhi ba'i nyams ldan no| |thun mong ma yin pa la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lta bu shin tu zhi bas spyan dkyus phra zhing ring ba sogs kyi nyams ldan dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje lta bu khro chags gnyis ka'i nyams tshang ba zhi ma khro dang*/ gshin rje gshed skor lta bu spom zhing thung ba srin po dang gnod sbyin gyi cha byad/ mi sdug pa'i ltas bco brgyad tshang bas shin tu khros pa dbu skra ma gtogs pa'i bzhengs pa'i dpangs la'ang zhal bzhi las med pa dang 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa zhes gsungs pa'i bstan don gur gyi mgon po lta bu dbu che zhing mjing pa nub pas/

zhal gsum gyi dpangs las med pas lhag par khros pa'o/ /sku de dag gi phyag mtshan gyi gtso bo rdo rje dang dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud sde du mar 'byung ba'i nang nas/ bshad rgyud rtse mo sogs nas 'byung ba la phyi dril dang*/ dus 'khor dang saṃ bu ṭi sogs nas 'byung ba nang dril zhes bya ste/ de dag la gsang sngags phyi nang du kun la grags shing rgyud nas kyang gsungs ba'i phyir ro/ /des na drang don rtags kyi rdor dril yin na phyi dril yin pas khyab bo zhes zer ba ni mkhas rlom dregs pa'i nga ro sgrogs par zad do/ /'di dag thams cad kyi phyag tshad sogs dang gzhan yang kha ṭwāṃ ga la sogs pa'i lag cha dang*| rgyan drug sogs kyi bshad pa ni/ kho bos rten gsum bzheng tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho dang*/ kyai rdor mchod 'phreng sogs su bshad par blta'o/ / gnyis pa gsung gi rten ni/ yi ge yin la/ de la yang yi ge'i ngo bo ni/ skad kyi gdangs te/ dbyangs dang gsal byed do/ /'dir bzo rig gi gnas su gzhag par bya ba ni/ yi ge'i gzugs yin la/ de yang mdo rgya che rol pa las yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad de/ 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i grwar zhugs te/ yi ge pa kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi drung du byon pa na/ des byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid ma bzod de kha bub tu 'gyel lo// de dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu yan lag bzang po zhes bya bas bslangs te/ yab zas gtsang la sogs pa skye bo mang po'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' la rgyas par bstod cing mchod nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsandan sbrul gyi snying po las byas pa'i yi ge'i glegs shing tshon gyis byugs pa gser gyi yang mig gis btags mtha' nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa thogs te/ slob dpon kun gyis bshes gnyen la 'di skad ces smras so/

/kye mkhan pos bdag la yi ge gang slob/ tshangs pa'i yi ge'am/ kha roṣta'i yi ge'am/ padma'i snying po'i yi ge'am/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ aṅga'i/ baṅga'i/ ma ga dha'i/ bkra shis pa'i| sor mo'i/ shā ka na'i/ ya pa na'i/ pa ga le'i/ pa ru sha'i/ 'gro lding pa'i/ ki ra ta'i/ lho phyogs pa'i/ drag shul can gyi/ grangs kyi/ spyi'u tshugs pa'i/ rjes su mthun pa'i/ bru sha'i/ kha che'i/ rgya'i/ pu na'i/ hu na'i/ 'bring rgyas su bri ba'i| rgyal gyi/ lha'i/ klu'i/ gnod sbyin gyi/ dri za'i/ mi'am ci'i/ lto 'phye chen po'i| lha ma yin gyi/ nam mkha' lding gi ri dwags 'khor lo'i/ bya rog sgra gcan gyi/ sa bla'i/ bar snang gi ba lang spyod kyi/ sgra mi snyan gyi/ lus 'phags po'i| 'degs pa'i/ bzhag pa'i/ bsnan pa'i/ rgya mtsho'i/ rdo rje'i/ spring yig dang len gyi/ rnam 'thor gyi/ rings med kyi/ bstan bcos skor ba'i/ rtsis skor ba'i| 'degs pa skor ba'i/ bzhag pa skor ba'i/ rkang pas bris pa'i/ tshig lan gnyis su gdab pa mtshams kyi/ tshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar gyi| bla thabs su bsnan pa'i/ sgra thams cad kun tu bsdus pa'i/ rig pa dang mthun pa'i/ rnam par 'dres pa'i/ drang srong gis dka' thub spyad pa'i/ ldeng ba'i| sa blta ba'i/ nam mkha' blta ba'i/ sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa'i/ snying po thams cad kun tu bsdus pa'i/ 'byung po thams cad kyi sgra bsdus pa'i yi ge ste/ kye slob dpon/ yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag gi nang nas bdag la gang bslab ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon nga rgyal dang dregs pa dang rgyags pa med par byas te ngo mtshar nas bzhin gyi 'dzum phyung ste/ sems can dag pa ngo mtshar che| |bstan bcos kun la bslabs gyur kyang*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten rjes bsnyeg phyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad du mas bstod do/ /de yang re re nas bgrangs na re bdun snang bas re bzhi zhes pa ma dag pa'am/

yang na sa bla dang bar snang gcig tu snang zhing*/ 'degs bzhag bsnan gsum gcig tu byas sam snyam mo/ /mdo 'dir ṛ l̥ bzhi bor ba'i dbyangs bcu gnyis dang*/ gsal byed ka sde sogs sde pa lnga dang*/ mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi dang kṣa yig ste so bzhi po rnams byis pa khri phrag gcig dang lhan cig brjod pa'i tshe/ mi rtag bdag med la sogs pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs gsal gyi grangs dang mnyam pa byung bas byis pa sum khri nyis stong byang chub tu smin par mdzad ces gsungs so/ /bod kyi yi ge ma bgrangs pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das rjes thon mis lha sa'i chos rgyal gyi dus su/ kha che'i yi ge la dpe byas nas gsar du brtsams pas yin la hor yig gsar du grags pa yang 'phags pa rin po ches gsar du mdzad pa'o/ /lañtsha dang wartu la la sogs pa'i gzugs ni mthong ba brgyud pas shes dgos shing rags pa'i rnam pa tsam sgra'i spyi don du bshad zin to/ /chos sku'am thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten du grags pa ste/ de yang bstan pa 'di'i mchod rten gyi gtso bo ni shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ste/ de rnams gang du bzhengs pa'i gnas dang dus dang ming dang bang rim gyi sgo nas dbyibs kyi khyad par ni/ kho bos snga mo'i dus su byas pa'i bstod pa 'dir gsal te/ na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ phun tshogs dge legs gzi 'od stong 'bar zhing*/ / ma lus 'phro ba'i nyer 'tsho phan bde'i gzhi/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i dbus na lham me ba/ /bde gshegs mchod rten lhun por gus phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa bltams tshe ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo bur dang bcas pa| |bang rim bzhi ldan sgo mang kyis spras pa'i/ /bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ga dha yi byang chub shing drung du/ /bdud sde bcom nas mngon par sangs rgyas tshe/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi bam rim bzhi ldan pa'i//

byang chub chen po'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /wa ra ṇā sir chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo bur dang bcas pa/ /bam rim bzhi ldan sgo mang gis dben pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yum la chos bstan nas/ /slar yang babs tshe gsal ldan du sbyangs pa| |chos 'khor lta bu gdang bus rab mdzes pa'i/ /lha las babs pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyan du yod par mu stegs pham byas tshe/ /legs sbyangs zlum po bang rim bzhi pa ni/ /padma'i dra bas mngon par spras pa yi/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po'i khab tu dge 'dun dbyen bzlums tshe/ /legs sbyangs byang chen lta bu zur bcad pas/ /zur brgyad logs brgyad kun nas cha mnyam pa'i/ /dbyen bzlums byams dngos mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /yangs pa can du sku tshe'i 'du byed ni/ /zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs zlum po bang rim gsum ldan pa/ /byin brlabs rnam rgyal mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtswa mchog grong du mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs bang rim gyis dben mgur chu yan/ /rab brjid seng khri'i dbus na lham me ba/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun kyang pad gdan seng khri rmad dge bcu/

/mgur chu bum pa bre dang bcu gsum gdugs| |char khebs tog sogs mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa'i/ /lha mi'i bsod nams rten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa gnas dang dus dang dbyibs kyi khyad par du byas pa 'di yang dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis sbyar ro/ /zhes te/ dus de dang de'i tshe gnas de dang de'i grong khyer pa rnams kyis dga' spro khyad par can gyis bzhengs zhing so so'i dus ston bzang po yang gnas de rnams su yod par gsungs so/ /'di ni gtsug tor dri med kyi 'grel par 'byung ba bzhin te/ phyag tshad cha chen dang cha phran gyi nges pa'ang dpal 'byor rgya mtshor gsal lo/ /dus 'khor las gsungs pa ni/ phyi ri rab kyi dbyibs dang*/ nang skyes bu'i lus tshad/ gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i skyil krung gi cha bang rim du don gyis thob cing*/ bum pa ni skyes bu dang ri rab kyi lus dngos/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar te dpung pa'i thad du je rgyas su song ba snying ga'i thad du padma'i 'phreng ba phyi la 'bur du dod pa bskor ba/ bre mgul mgrin pa'i dpangs dang bre gdong ni byad bzhin gyi dpangs tshad phyir la 'phyar ba dang bcas pa/ phyogs kyi gsum cha'i glo 'bur can te 'og gi bang rim la song*/ /bre'i steng du gdugs ni skra mtshams yan chad zhal gang gi tshad can char khebs sogs don gyis thob pa'o/ /de ltar na lugs 'di sor bzhag la mchod rten brgyad kyi mtshan nyid so sor med do/ /lugs gnyis ka la yang seng khri ni ma bshad pas ci mdzes so/ /de ltar na rdzogs sangs rgyas la sogs so/ / rang sangs rgyas la sogs ni rgyas par bshad na mang la/ mdor bsdus rtogs sla zhing dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba mchod pa dang gdug pa 'dul ba'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur gar gyi rnam gzhag la/

mig gi lta stangs/ lag pa'i phyag rgya/ rkang pa'i stang stabs la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyang lus bzor gtso bor bsdu ste/ rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba la gtso bor bslab bo/ /lus bzo phal pa ni/ khang khyim khyad par can khang pa brtsegs pa khang mig lnga brgya pa la sogs pa dang*/ gru gzings sogs kyang rgyas par bshad mod kyi/ bod na med pa'i gru gzings dang shing rta sogs ni rtogs par dka'o/ /gzhan yang gza' btung khyad par can gyi g.yo stangs rgyan gos khyad par can gyi bzo tshem la sogs pa'ang shes par bya zhing*/ gos dra ba dang drub pa dang 'gru ba dang 'chag pa dang kha sgyur ba sogs ni 'dul ba'i gos gzhi na'ang gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ngag bzo ni/ rgyal ba mchod pa'i bstod dbyangs sogs ni gtso bo ste/ rgod bag med par dad pas bya dgos par/ bstod phyag dang rgyun chags gsum pa sogs kyi dbyangs kyi nga ro bya bar mdo lung dang rgyud sder rgyas par gsungs so/ /des na skad gdangs che zhing snyan pa 'byung ba'i thabs kyi sman dang dpyad dang spyod lam bsten cing zlog phyogs spang la/ 'gyur dang khugs dang 'degs dang 'jog sbom dang phra ba ste drug ldan la sogs pa'i gdangs kyi rnam 'gyur du ma la byang bar byas nas bod snga ma la grags pa'i mdo lugs kyi dbyangs dang*/ lo chen lo chung gis spel ba'i yo ga'i dbyangs dang*/ chos skyong zhi drag gi bstod bskul la sogs pa yang mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun las legs par bslab dgos la/ sna tshogs rol mo'i cha byad/ rnga bo che dang rnga pa ṭa ha dang*/ rdza rnga dang zom rnga dang gling bu dang pi waṃ dang rgyud mang la sogs pa dang*/ dung dang zangs dung rag dung la sogs pa mtha' yas pa rnams kyi gzugs bzo ba la mkhas pa ni lus bzo yin la/ 'dir rol mo'i skad gdangs 'don pa la mkhas pa ni ngag bzo'o/ /yid kyi bzo ni thos bsam sogs mtha' yas so/ / de la brtag pa brgyad ni/

sa gzhi dang*/ rin po che dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ gos dang*| glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med brtag pa ste/ dang po ni phyi nang gi dpyad rgyas pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad cing*/ gzhan rnams kyi gzhung lugs khungs thub bod du ma byon la/ mi dpyad rta dpyad sogs 'ga' re snang ba ni yid ches kyi gnas su ma mthong bas ma bris so/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor pho mo'i dpyad du ma ni rgyud sde rnams su 'byung bas de dag gi rnam bshad du gsal lo/ /rig gnas bco brgyad ni/ bram ze rnams kyi las/ gsang sngags dang rgyud kyi rig pa/ cho ga zhib mo'i rig pa/ gtan tshigs kyi rig pa nas| gnas 'dug gi rig pa'i bar bco brgyad 'dul ba lung las gsungs so| |skar rtsis ni/ rgya gar nas 'byung ba lnga bsdus dang sgra gcan gdong mjug dang*| lo 'pho zla 'pho dang nyi zla gza' 'dzin dang*/ gza' lnga'i rtsis dang*/ dus sbyor gyi rtsis dang khyad par yul drug gi dus sbyor sogs te kho bos gzhan du rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bshad do/ /dbyangs 'char ni gtso bor dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus las gsungs la/ de dang cha mthun zhing phal cher dgag par bya ba ni dbang phyug chen pos bshad pa'i rgyud glo bo lo tsā bas bsgyur ba la kun dga' zla ba'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa deng sang grags che ste de la brten pa'i dus sbyor sogs kyi rnam gzhag zur na gsal lo/ /nag rtsis ni/ rgya nag nas 'byung ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pas bdag gi rigs brtag pa la shin tu nye bar mkho yang bod kyi pha jo blun pos mang du bslad pas rnam dag zur na bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yid bzo thos bsam bya yul du ma 'dus pa'i rig gnas med pa de'i phyir bzo'i rig gnas 'dir rig gnas mtha' dag 'dus pas rig gnas kun gyi lus yin pa'i phyir zas 'tshol ba'i rig gnas zhes brnyas par mi bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/

de dag phal cher sogs te brjod zin to/ /rig gnas dang po cung zad bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // gsum pa gso rig la/ gso rig gi dgos pa/ de'i byung khungs/ de'i rang bzhin/ de'i kha 'phangs so/ / dang po ni/ rig gnas gnyis pa gso ba rig pa ni don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi mchog tu grub ste/ 'gro kun sogs de'i phyir te/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad/ /rjes su 'brel bas lus kun khyab gyur pa| |zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i zag bcas las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi lus ni 'byung bzhi 'dus pa las 'byung la/ 'byung bzhi ni tsha grang mi mthun pas de la brten pa'i nad rlung mkhris bad kan cha snyoms na nad med byed mod kyang tsha grang cha snyoms su zas dang spyod lam du mas mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'byung lus rags pa yang sku rgyab bsnyung ba sogs su gdul bya thun mong ba mtha' dag la snang zhing gzugs khams kyi lha chen tshangs pa la yang sgra gcan gyi 'khor los dpral bar snad pa'i zug rngus brgyal bar phyi rol pa kun la thun mong du grags shing grub pa'i phyir ro| | gnyis pa la rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ tshangs pa nas brgyud tshul/ rgya gar du dar tshul/ bod du byon tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ thub pa'i dbang po sogs te/ rgyud sde spyir yang lus kyi chags tshul dang de'i khams 'khrugs pas nad skyed tshul dang de la phan pa'i phyi nang gi sman dang dpyad la sogs pa gsungs pa rnams lam 'bras la sogs pa'i man ngag du mar bsdus shing*/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang ler/ dang por mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni sngags pa rnams kyis dngos grub rgyu ru yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /zhes sogs bsrung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan khyad par can gsungs nas/ bsrung thabs kyi gtso bo rnal 'byor gyi rlung sbyor/ bsrung thabs phal pa sman dang bcud len/ sman la yang kun spangs kyis rang gi lus la yod pa'i sman/

mi bskyod pa ni cung zad dro bas kha nad zhi bar byed de so yi zug rngu nyid la yang*/ zhes sogs du ma dang*/ 'byor ldan gyi phyi'i sman/ rlung 'joms lan tshwa skyur po dag tu rab tu 'gyur te mngar dang bska ba dag ni mkhṛs pa'i dgra| |zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ bcud len yang*/ dman 'bring mchog gsum dang chen po'i chen po ro chen gyi sbyor ba sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'dul ba lung sman gyi gzhi las/ sman rnam pa bzhi'i bsten tshul sogs dang*/ gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde sogs su yang gsungs te de dang der blta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol pa la grags pa/ lha min stobs ldan gyis/ ri rab kyis srubs shing*/ klu'i rgyal po gnyis kyis srubs thag byas nas phyi'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pas dug dang bdud rtsi dang zla nyi la sogs pa byung ba'i dug dbang phyug gis 'thungs pas mgrin sngon du song ba sogs kyi tshe/ tshangs pas bdud rtsi sgos su khyer bas/ sgra gcan gyis 'khor lo bsnun pa dpral bar phog pas shin tu snad nas yun ring du brgyal/ de las bsos dran pa rnyed nas phan pa'i thabs bsams pas/ sngon ston pa las sman gyi rgyud thos pa rnams brjed bsos te rang gi nad kyang bcos shing*/ skye rgu'i bdag po zhes pa tshangs pa gnyis pa zhig la rgya cher bstan/ des tha skar gyi bu gnyis zhes pa sngon gyi rgyal po skya bseng gi bu lngar grags pa'i 'thab brtan chos kyi bu/ 'jigs sde rlung gi bu/ srid sgrub dbang po'i bu/ rigs med lhar bcas gnyis skar ma tha skar gyi bu yin pa'i nang nas tha ma gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la brgyud pa nas bzung ste/ kho bos byas pa'i gso dpyad spyi don du bkod pa bzhin lha'i drang srong du ma la brgyud do/ / gsum pa ni/ ston pa bzhugs tshe sogs te/ 'dul ba gos gzhi'i gleng gzhir rgyas par 'gyur ba bzhin du/

thub pa snyun gso'i sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos zhes grags te/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la btsun mo'i bu ma skyes dgra zur bu che ba/ yangs pa can gyi a smra skyong ma dang 'grogs pa las byung ba/ gzhon nu 'jigs med ces pa la/ rgyal po'i khab nyid kyi tshong dpon gyi chung ma zhig dang 'grogs pa las 'di byung nas rang gi phu'o gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis 'di gsos pas gzhon nus gsos zhes bya'i/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu zhes pa ni ming gi zur nyams la/ gzhon nu gso zhes pa'ang rnam dbye nyams so/ /rgyun shes gyi bu nas 'di las brgyud pa'ang rigs na'ang ma mthong la/ me bzhin 'jug sogs nas mi'i drang srong brgyud tshul rgyas pa'ang spyi don du gsal zhing*/ khyad par lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed sogs te/ mkhas mchog dpa' po ni/ dbu ma la legs ldan sogs rang rgyud pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs thal 'gyur bar gyes kyang / 'phags pa klu sgrub dang ārya de ba ni phyogs su ma lhung bas gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa zhes bod na gsal bar grags pa'i nang du gzhug dgos par nges te/ 'dis mdzad pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi bsgom rim khyad par can rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba la bltas pas lta ba'i mthar thug dang ldan par gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dang 'dul byed 'phags pa lha'i rnam thar dang 'dis gzhung lugs dang phrin las mdzad tshul yang sman gyi spyi don na gsal lo/ / bzhi pa ni/ dpa' bo yab sras de nas brgyud pa ring thung gnyis su legs par brgyud pa skyes mchog rin chen bzang po nas brgyud de sman gyi rgyud bzhi byung tshul gyi bar yang snga ma bzhin te 'dir ldab nas ma bris so/ / gsum pa la yang*/ mdzad pa po sangs rgyas byang sems/ lha mi'i drang srong sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rgya gar rgya nag hor dang ge sar bod la sogs pa'i gso dpyad kyi rnam gzhag du ma yod par grags kyang*/

gzhung gi mthar thug pa mkhas rmongs kun la mthun snang du grub pa/ khungs nas brgyud/ mkhas pas bshad| lo chen gyis bsgyur/ mkhas grub la grags pa ni/ gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa 'di'o/ /'di'i gzhung tshad/ brjod bya yan lag brgyad/ brjod tshul gnas drug le'u brgya nyi shu/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ phyi ma'i rgyud de rgyud gsum du bsdu tshul sogs ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ / 'on kyang 'di nyams su len pa po'i gang zag gi bsam sbyor dang*/ blang bya le'u so so'i brjod bya bsdus te bstan na 'di lta ste/ spyir 'jig rten pa'i tshong dang so nam sogs don du gnyer bas kyang*/ rang gi 'tsho ba'i lhag ma gang byung bla ma dkon mchog gi phyogs su gtong bar 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ mi dge bcu spong gi nang nas sna re sna gnyis yan chad ji tsam nus pa spong ba sogs dang*/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde nas 'byung ba'i ya rabs kyi spyod pa'i ngang nas bya bar gsungs te| gzhung 'di'i mdo gnas le'u gnyis pa nyin re spyod pa'i le'u las/ sems can thams cad bde 'dod phyir/ /rtsom pa kun la 'jug par 'dod/ /bde ba chos med par ma yin/ /de bas chos la brtson par bya/ /mos pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /cig shos ring du spang bar bya/ /'tshe dang rgyu dang 'dod log spyod/ /phra ma ngag rtsub rdzun tshig dang*/ /ma 'brel smra dang gnod sems dang*| |brnab sems lta ba phyin ci log /de ltar sdig pa'i las rnam bcu/ / lus ngag yid kyis spang bar bya/ /phongs pa nad pa mya ngan gzir/ /ci nus par ni phan gdags phyir/ /'bu srin grog sbur dag la yang*/ /rang dang 'dra ba lta bar bya/ /lha dang dge slong bram ze dang*/ /sman pa rgan rgyal mgron 'ongs mchod| |slong la rgyab kyis phyogs mi bya/ /brnyas par mi bya tshar mi gcod/ / ces sogs sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa dang khyad par/ gnod par byed brtson dgra gzhan la'ang*/

/phan gdags pa ni gtso bor bya/ /zhes sogs bdag pas gzhan gces dang*/ 'byor rgud la yang yid gcig bya/ /rgyu la phrag dog 'bras bu min/ /zhes sogs brtan zhing bsran tshugs pa dang*/ rgyu nas btsos kyi 'bras bu grub zin la bzod par bya ba sogs bsam sbyor khyad par can du ma dang*| sbrid pa gad mo glal ba la/ kha ni gdang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes sogs 'phral gyi kun spyod 'dul ba ltar zhib pa mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang chos dang mi mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs dang bza' btung thams cad spang zhing*| mdor na 'jig rten mdzangs pa'i kun spyod mtha' dag ni dam pa'i chos dang mthun pas de la bslab par gsungs te/ blo ldan sbyor ba thams cad la/ / 'jig rten nyid ni slob dpon yin/ /de bas 'jig rten pa yi don*/ /rtogs par bya ba de nyid bya/ zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ 'jig rten tshul lugs gang dang gang*/ /de dang de la chos rjes 'jug de yi phyir na chos pas kyang*/ /'jig rten stobs ldan lta bur snang*/ /zhes dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*| |zhes sogs gsungs pa dang mthun mod kyi/ /deng sang gi 'jig rten ya rabs kyi chos lugs byas na tshe 'di mi 'grub par byas nas rgyal rigs ngan pa'i gzhung dang chom rkun gyi gzhung lugs tshad mar byed pas ya rabs kyi spyod tshul nub pa'i phyir na/ de spyod par 'dod pas gzhung lugs 'di lta bur chos gtso bor ston pa la bslab cing*/ khyad par sman pa'i bsam sbyor gyi gtso bo gzhan phan gyi bya ba nyid lhur blangs nas nyams su blangs na/ mthar thug sangs rgyas la nye bar ma zad 'phral gyi blun po la grags pa'i sman bsod sogs kyang bde blag tu 'byung bar nges so/ /de skad du yang*/ le'u de'i mjug tu/ snying rjes brlan zhing gtong dang ldan/ /lus dang ngag yid dul ba dang*/

/gzhan gyi don la rang don sems/ /de dag dam pa'i spyod mthar thug /ces dang*/ de ltar dpyod pa mdor bsdus pas/ /gang zhig kun tu sbyong byed pa/ /tshe dang nad med dbang phyug dang*/ /grags pa 'jig rten rtag thob 'gyur/ /zhes so/ khyad par du| |rang gzhan gyi tshe bsring bar 'dod pa'i kun slong gis/ chos dang 'byor pa sgrub cing sman dpyad kyi gzhung 'di la nan tan du bya bar gsungs te/ mgo'i bshad par dam bca' las/ tshe ni ring bar 'dod pa yis/ /chos dang nor dang bde ba sgrub/ /tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa/ /rab tu gus par bya bar gyis/ /

tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin/ /de yis tha skar des brgya byin/ /des rgyun shes sogs drang srong la'o/ /de yis me bzhin 'jug la sogs/ /de rnams kyis kyang so sor byas/ /shin tu 'thor pa de rnams las/ /rab gces phal cher btus pa ni/ /shin tu bsdus min rgyas min par| |yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bya/ /zhes sogs so/ /brjod bya yan lag brgyad ni/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro tsa/ / gso dpyad gang la gnas gyur pa/ /yan lag brgyad ces de la brjod/ /ces so| | le'u so so'i brjod bya ni/ mdo gnas le'u dang po tshe ring ba'i le'us ni/ brjod bya yan lag brgyad/ nad gsum gyi ngo bo/ sman dang sman pa/ nad pa dang nad g.yog rnams chos bzhi ldan sogs kyi sman dpyad spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ le'u brgya nyi shu'i mtshan rnams bstan no/ /gnyis pa nyin re'i spyod pa'i le'us ni| zhag gcig gi khrus dang gtsang sbra sgo gsum gyi kun spyod bstan no/ /gsum pa dus su spyad pa'i le'us ni/ lo gcig dus drug dang bzhi la sogs pa'i tshe nad ldang tshul dang zas spyod so sor bsten tshul lo/ /de bzhin du nad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i dpyad kyis ni/ dus de rnams su nad gsar du mi gsog pa'i sman dang dpyad dang*/ gal te bsags na/ dgun bsags pa dpyid dang*/ dpyid bsags pa dbyar sel tshul sogs so/ /lnga pa chu snod sogs kyi bye brag shes pas ni/ chu dang 'o ma bu ram shing*// til mar chang gi sde tshan rim/ /zhes de rnams kyi sde tshan ston no/ /drug pa kha zas kyi tshul bstan pa ni/ gra ma can dang*/ gang bu chags pa dang*| |g.yos su byas pa dang*/ sha dang tshod ma dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ tshwa rnams kyi sde tshan rgyas pa'o/ /bdun pa kha zas srung bas ni/ rang gis bslabs sam/ sman pa mkhas pa rang gi drung du bzhag nas zas spyod gnod par 'gyur ba bsrung shing phan pa bsten tshul lo/

/brgyad pa la zas tshod bzung gi le'us ni/ de'i tshul rgyas par ro/ /dgu pa sman sogs kyi bye brag shes par bya bas ni/ sman gyi ro nus sogs rgya cher ro/ bcu pa ro tha dad shes par bya bas ni/ ro drug gi sde tshan no/ /bcu gcig pa nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes pas ni/ nad dang*/ lus zungs dang*/ dri ma'i dbye ba'o/ /bcu gnyis pa nad kyi bye brag shes pas ni/ nad rnams lus kyi gnas so sor ldang tshul dang*/ yang lci dang 'phel zad dang*/ de dag la brten pa'i dbye ba sogs so/ /bcu gsum pa nad gso thabs kyis ni/ nad gsum dang ldan 'dus gso tshul lo/ /bcu bzhi pa gso thabs rnam pa gnyis pas ni/ lus brtas shing rgyas pa dang*| nyams smad cing bsnyung bar byed tshul lo/ /bco lnga pa sbyang pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan sna tshogs 'dus pas ni/ skyug sman| 'khru sman/ 'tsho byed/ lung sel gyi sde la sogs te nad sna tshogs sel ba ston no/ / bcu drug pa snum gyi cho gas ni/ rlung nad gtso bor gyur pa la snum par byed pa'i thabs so/ /bcu bdun pa dugs kyi cho gas ni/ dugs sna tshogs sau/ /bco brgyad pa 'khru skyug cho gas ni/ de gnyis rgyas pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ bcu dgu pa mas gtang tshogs dang*/ nyi shu pa sna nas gtang ba'i dang*/ nyer gcig pa dud pa gtang ba'i ngang*/ nyer gnyis pa mkhur ba dgang ba'i/ nyer gsum pa mig tu thigs pa blug pa'i/ nyer bzhi pa mig brtas par byed pa'i/ nyer lnga pa gtar dang dpyad kyi/ nyer drug pa gtar dpyad kyi/ nyer bdun pa gtar ga gdab pa'i/ nyer brgyad pa zug rngu dbyung ba'i/ nyer dgu pa gtar ga gdab pa'i las kyi/ sum cu pa thal sman rnon po dang me btsa' gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u rnams kyis ni rang ming gi cho ga rgyas par gsungs te/ tshul rgyas par ma spros so/ mdo gnas le'u sum cu'o/ /gnas gnyis pa lus gnas le'u drug ni/ lus kyi rum du zhugs pa'i dang*|

de'i nad kyi bye brag gi dang*/ lus kyi yan lag gi bye brag gi dang*/ lus kyi gnad kyi bye brag gi dang*/ lus kyi 'gyur ba'i bye brag gi dang*/ lus kyi pho ha'i bye brag rnams kyi le'u ste/ rim bzhin khu khrag gi skyon yon nyal po bya tshul/ mngal chags nas bskyed tshul/ btsa' khar ji ltar bya tshul sogs rgyas pa dang*/ mngal ma'i zas spyod kyi rkyen ngan pas nad skyed tshul sman dang bcas pa sogs dang*| lus la yan lag drug dang*/ rus pa dang tshigs sum brgya drug cu sogs yod tshul dang*/ brla gnyis dang lag ngar gnyis la gnad bcu gcig re dang*/ lto ba la gsum dang brang la dgu dang*/ rgyab la bcu bzhi dang*/ nam tshod yan chad la sor bdun te gnad brgya dang bdun dang gzhan yang gnad ming can 'ga' rnams la gtar me sogs byas nas skyon skyed tshul dang*/ sman pa bzhugs pa'i pho nya ba mchog dman dang de yi rgyan gos dri tshig sogs la brtag pa dang*/ sman pa dang nad pa gnyis ka'i rmi lam brtag pa rnams rgya cher gsungs so/ /gnas gsum pa nad bzhi'i le'u bcu drug ni/ rlung sogs spyi'i/ rims nad kyi/ khrag mkhris lud pa'i/ dbugs mi 'de ba dang skyigs bu'o/ /glo gcong chen po'i/ chang nad kyi/ gzhang 'brum gyi/ tshad pas 'khru ba dang pho ba'i/ gcin 'gags pa sri ba'i/ gcin rnyi za gu'i/ khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs dang skran gyi/ rmu rdzing gi skya rbab dang 'or nad kyi/ mdze dang sha bkra dang za gu dang srin bu'i nad kyi/ rlung nad kyi/ dreg nad kyi nad gzhi'i le'u rnams te/ rang rang gi ming gis bstan pa'i nad de rnams kyi rgyu dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur sogs so/ /gnas bzhi pa nad gso ba'i gnas la/ nad gzhi gnyis pa rims gso ba nas brtsams te nyi shu rtsa gnyis gsungs so/ /de yang 'di ltar rims nad dang*/ khrag mkhris dang*/ lud pa dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ gcong chen gso ba ste lnga| rlon nad ces pa skom dad dang*/

chang nad dang*/ gzhang 'brum dang*/ tshad nad dang*/ pho nad gso ba ste lnga/ gcin nad gnyis zhes pa sri ba dang rnyi ba/ khong 'bras dang*/ skran dang rmu rdzing gso ba ste lnga/ skya rbab dang*/ 'or nad dang*/ me dbal dang*/ mdze dang*/ sha bkra dang*/ rlung nad dang*/ dreg nad gso ba ste bdun rnams so/ /'di dag las btus shing phyi ma'i le'u sogs nas kha bkangs te/ lag len gces bsdus zhes bya ba le'u bcu pa zhig kyang kho bos zur na byas par gsal lo/ /gnas lnga pa cho ga grub pa'i gnas le'u drug ni/ skyug sman gyi/ bkru sman gyi/ de gnyis nges par grub pa'i cho ga re re/ mas gtang gi de nges par grub pa'i cho ga rnams te/ 'di la dpe 'ga' rer nyes par grub pa zhes 'byung ba ni/ da ltar yang yul skad ma dag pa 'ga' rer/ nges pa can du 'dug zer rgyu la nyes pa can du 'dug ces zer ba bzhin du sgra nyams pa yin gyi/ nyes par grub pa bcos pa'i le'u zhes tshig snon mi dgos so/ /yang kha cig sman gyis ma grub kyang*/ dpyad chen 'dis nad med grub pas na cho ga grub pa'o/ /zhes zer ba yang don ma yin te/ skyug sman bkru sman mas gtang ste cho ga gsum dang*/ de gsum bogs 'don lta bu'i sgo nas nges par grub pa gsum ste le'u drug yin no/ /gnas drug pa phyi ma'i gnas le'u bzhi bcu pas/ byis pa gso ba la gsum/ gdon gso ba la bzhi/ lus kyi stod gso ba la bcu bdun/ rma la bcu/ dug la bzhi/ rgas pa dang ro tsa gso ba la le'u re re rnams so/ /de yang dang po gsum ni/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi/ de'i nad kyi/ de'i gdon gyi le'u'o/ de nas bzhi ni/ 'byung po'i gdon dmigs shes par bya ba dang*| de gso ba/ smyo byed kyi dang brjed byed kyi gdon gso ba rnams so/ /bcu bdun po yang*/ lus stod kyi gtso bo mig gso ba la dgu dang*/ gzhan la brgyad do| |dgu ni mig mchu zhes pa yas lcebs mas lcibs su grags pa dang*/

rdzi ma dang*| grwa zur rnams la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang*/ de gso ba'i le'u ste gnyis gnyis/ mig 'bras dang*/ rab rib dang/ mthong nyams te gsum gso ba gsum ste dgu'o/ gzhan la/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ kha dang*/ mgo bo ste/ bzhi la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang de gso ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad do/ /rma la/ rma spyi dang*/ 'phral gyi rma dang*/ chag grums dang*/ mtshan par rdol ba rnams gso ba ste bzhi/ 'bras sogs dang*/ phra mo'i nad dang*/ gsang ba'i nad rnams la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang*/ de dang de gso ba gnyis gnyis te drug rnams so/ /dug la/ dug nad spyi/ sbrul gyi/ srin bu'i/ byi ba'i dug rnams gso ba'o/ /rgas pa gso ba ni bcud len gyi le'u'o/ /ro tsa gso ba ni| bud med sa bon gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o/ 'di'i mjug tu/ rgyun shes bus sbyar ba'i nad sna tshogs gso ba'i mdo yang bzhugs so/ /le'u'i mtshan 'di dag ni le'u dang po'i mjug tshigs bcad du yod pas le'u dang po 'di la brjod bya kun 'dus pas rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ste/ chos rje zhig po la sogs pa bod kyi mkhas pas zur du ṭī ka yang byas so/ /le'u 'dir gso dpyad kyi brjod bya mtha' dag don bzhi dang bzhi po re re yang bzhi bzhi tshang dgos par bstan te/ gso ba dag tu bstan pa ni/ sman pa sman dang nad g.yog dang*/ / nad pa yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ /re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin/ /sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung don shes/ /las rnams mthong zhing gtsang ba yin/ /sman ni cho ga mang po dang*/ /yon tan mang ldan phun tshogs 'phrod/ /nad g.yog rjes brtse gtsang sbra can/ /sgrin zhing blo dang ldan pa yin/ /nad pa phyug cing bsgo ba nyan/ / shes par nus shing snying stobs ldan/ /zhes so/ /mkhas stegs ni/ mkhas pa brgyud pa'i man ngag can no/ /de ma go bar mkhas bsten zhes pa 'chos pa'ang yod mod snga ma 'chun che'o/ /gzhung gzhan 'dul ba'i gzhung du nad la bkres skom dang*/

'du ba'i nad ces pa gnyis su bsdus zhes sogs kyang go sla'o/ dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud du bzhed pa'ang de bzhin te/ 'dir rgyas par 'chad pa skabs min pas sbyor drug gi gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho sogs su blta'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ spyir rgya gar rgya nag bod sogs gso dpyad spyi 'byung tshul/ khyad par mkhas mchog dpa' po'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ de 'dul byed 'phags pa lha'i rnam thar dang bcas pa/ de nas lo chen la rim gyis brgyud tshul/ bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi dbye bsdu/ sman dpyad spyi'i rnam gzhag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzhung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gcig dang*/ lag len gces bsdus reg pas nad sel zhes pa le'u bcu pa kun la mkho ba gcig ste sman dpyad kyi yi ge gnyis tsam gzhan du bshad zin pas gzhung 'dir ni de tsam la bsdu'o zhes pa'o/ /le'u gnyis pa'i bshad pa'o// // rig gnas gsum pa sgra rig la yang dgos pa dang byung tshul dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ kha 'phangs so/ /dang po ni/ tshig gi bsgrub gzhi byings kyi 'jog tshul dang*/ des sgrub byed kyi rkyen la las kyi don la byed pa dang byed pa'i don la las sbyor ba sogs dang*/ de tshig tu sgrub pa'i rnam dbye sbyin mi dgos pa dang*/ dgos kyang gang dran gyis chog par 'dod pa sogs sgra don gnyis kyi nang nas dang po la log par smra ba thams cad ni rig gnas 'di mi shes na sel thabs med pas shin tu dgos pa che'o/ /gnyis pa la yang*/ rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ rgyal sras kyis mdzad tshul/ rgya gar du byon tshul/ bod du 'gyur tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ sgra rig pa ni/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong sogs kyis byas pa yin gyi rgyal ba'i gsung rab las mi 'byung ngo snyam na/ spyir chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa ste bzhi'i gsum pa 'chad par mdzad pa'i tshe/ yul ljongs kyi skad rigs dang*/

nges tshig mtha' dag la slob dgos tshul dang*/ skad rigs spyi dang khyad par saṃ skṛ ta la yi ge dbri ba dang bsnan pa dang bsgyur ba dang*/ tshig thams cad ka lā pa ltar na si swo ti sogs dang*/ tsand+ra pa'i brda las sup dang ting gi mtha' can gyi rnam dbye gang rung can du gsal bar gsung la/ khyad par 'khor lo tha ma'i mdor gtogs pa bde gshegs snying po rgya cher ston pa rnga bo che chen po'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la sangs rgyas rtag pa dang bdag la sogs pa med pas de dag ni phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas pa'o zhes smra bar 'gyur yang de lta ma yin te/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las rgyas par 'byung tshul gsungs shing*/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la skad kyi byings la sogs pa med pas de dag phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas so zhes smra bar 'gyur yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la byings la sogs pa yod par gsungs te/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston yang don la thar pa'am myang 'das ni rtag brtan ther zug yin pas skye 'jig med pa'i dpe khang bzang zhig kyang de'i nam mkha' mi 'jig pa dang gzhan yang*/ de dper byas na ṣidhu zhes bya ba'i skad kyi byings kyi de na nikta zhes bya ba'i rkyen gyis de grub pa zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin du 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos rnams las/ nā mā khyā ta u pa sarga kṛ ta ta da dhi ta zhes bya ba la sogs pas bsdus pa'i grub pa'i tshig de la grub pa zhes bya'o/ /grub pa'i cho ga de'i grub pa gang yin pa de ni yang mi mngon pa med do zhes/ byings rkyen gyis bsgyur yang byings kyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba ni thar pa'i dper gsungs shing*/ sgrub tshul de dag ston pa'i gzhung ni/ nā ma zhes pa ming le dang*/ ā khyata kun bshad/ kri ta zhes pa krita kyi le'u ste/ sgra'i lus gzhung tshan gsum du bsdus shing*/

de dag gi rnam 'gyur dang nyer mkho ni/ u pa sasga nyer bsgyur dang tad dhi ta de phan la sogs pas bsdus pa'i gzhung ngo*/ /de yang ṣi dhu bstan bcos la ste bkra shis la'ang ngo zhes pa'i byings la las yakta'o zhes kta'i rkyen byin/ byings kyi dang po'i ṣa'i sa dang*/ dha da ru bsgyur ba'i cho ga dang*/ /rkyen gyi ka yon tan 'gog pa'i rjes 'brel dang*/ te dha ru bsgyur ba'i cho ga yod pa rnams byas pas/ siddhi zhes sa ma sid dhi zhes pa grub pa/ grub pa la 'jug pa'i grub pa'i tshig ste/ brda sprod pa ci dgar klog pa dag gis ṣidha zhes sogs su 'don srid kyang*/ /thob thang bzhin du byed na ma 'ongs pa'i chos ma 'ongs na'ang mi 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad kyi byings ni mkhas shing khong du chud pa'o zhes gsungs te/ bu dha khong du chud pa'am rtogs pa la'o zhes pa'i byings las sgrub ces gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs/ dus 'khor dbyangs 'char kyi mdor bsdus kyi thog mar gsal te/ der/ dbyangs dag gi dang po a yig yin pa de ni a sogs lnga ste/ a i ṛ u l̥ zhes pa rang byung gis bshad pa'o// a i u ṇa/ ṛ l̥ ka zhes pa ni so sor bsdu ba gzung phyir ro/ /e o tsa zhes pa klag pa las mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ste/ i yig dang u yig dag gi yon tan gyis so/ /ṛ ka'i a ṇa las ra la dag go zhes pa'i mdo'i phyir ṛ l̥ dag ni ma ning du mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis kyang yon tan dang ldan pas i yig la sogs pa rnams dang khyad par med do/ /zhes sogs nas/ de dag kyang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dbang gis grangs bzhin du 'jam dpal gyis rang gi brda sprod pa las bris zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ tshangs pa rtag zhi bas byas pa'i sgra mdo dang*/ de las brgya byin gyis bsdus pa dang*/

de la phur bus sbyangs tshul sogs ni gzhung gis gsal te lha yul du byung tshul lo/ /de dag la brten nas rgya gar du bram ze pā ṇi nis byas tshul sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ snga ma tsand+ra pa'i rnam dbye'i bshad pa sub mtha' rin cen 'byung gnas la sogs pa sgra rig dngos kyi rgya gzhung gong du brjod pa dang ma brjod pa yang bstan 'gyur dkar chag na gsal ba rnams dang*/ sgra rig pa'i yan lag tu gtogs pa'i sdeb sbyor sogs/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang de'i gcung blo brtan dang*/ dpang blo gros brtan pa dang*/ sras lo chen byang rtse dang*/ de'i bu chen lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos slob phan gyi 'gyur bcos shing phran mang po yang bsgyur/ de'i slob ma lo tsā ba shes rab dpal dang*/ de dpon slob gnyis ka la gtugs pa bdag gi bla ma sems dpa' chen po thugs rje dpal bzang pos tsand+ra pa'i 'grel pa dharma dā sa dang*/ u ṇa'i 'grel pa sogs bsgyur cing bshad pas/ spyir chos rje sa paṇa yan la tha snyad kyi rig gnas ma dar zhing de nas thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan yan la dar yang bod skad du ma bsgyur mod kyi/ sgra rig dngos ni dpang lo yab sras kyis bsgyur cing bshad nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas rig gnas 'di la shin tu bka' drin che'o/ /gsum pa la thun mong dang de min gyi yan lag gnyis las/ dang po la/ yi ge dang*/ ming dang*/

tshig gsum ste/ sgra'i spyi don na gsal zhing rgyas la 'dir bsdus shing gsal lo/ /thun mong min pa ni/ dpang los rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar| rang bzhin dang*/ rkyen dang*/ rnam 'gyur gsum du sdud par rgya gar gyi gzhung rnams na dngos su mi gsal yang nges par don gyis thob pas shin tu legs so/ /de la dang po la rang bzhin ni/ rkyen gyis zlas drangs pa'i tshe/ byings dang*/ ming ngam rtags gnyis ka'ang rang bzhin du bya dgos te/ rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su bsgrub par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang byings ni/ sgra mdo rnams su sgrub tshul rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis gsungs te/ ka lā par ming gis dang kun bshad kyis dang*/ tsand+ra par sub mtha' can dang ting mtha' can gyis sgrub tshul lo/ /sgrub tshul dang po'i dbang du byas nas brjod bya'i don cung zad ston yang gsal por mi ston pa lha sku'i rus tshugs lta bu ste/ rkyen gyi nang nas gtso bor kṛ ta'i rkyen ster ba'i gzhir gyur pa ste de byin nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston yang bya byed sogs kyi sgo nas gsal bar mi ston pa lha sku tshon gyis spras kyang rgyan dang spyan dbye ma sbyar ba lta bu ste/ ming ngam rtags zhes pa si sogs kyi rnam dbye sbyar ba'i gzhi yin pas 'di la'ang rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de la rnam dbye sbyar nas tshig tu rdzogs par grub pa ni/ de dag kyang legs par sbyar ba'i lha sku lta bu'o/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ bya ba rtogs byed ni byings so zhes dang*/ rkyen pha rol lo/ / zhes pas/ dus dang don gyi bya ba rtogs shing ston par byed pa'i gzhi'o/ /rtogs byed dngos ni/ ti sogs rnam dbye ste/ sde tshan bcu yod pa'i/ brta mā na sogs brgyad kyis dus dang*/ sde tshan gnyis pa sabha mī bar gsum pa sapta mīs don rtogs par byed pas de dag byin pa nyid kyis bar du rkyen gzhan sbyin pa la mi ltos par tshig nyid du gsal bar 'grub ba'o/

/byings la dbye na/ glegs bam nas 'byung ba'i dang*/ mdo las 'byung ba'i dang*/ ming gi dang*/ de las gzhan ba'i byings te bzhi zhes gsung yang phyi ma gnyis la rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings zhes gcig tu byas nas gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ byings mdo le'u dgu nas 'byung ba bhū yod pa la'o zhes sogs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ mañdzu mdo'i byings so zhes sogs byings mdo na med pa 'grel pa rnams kyis zur nas rnyed pa 'ga' re la zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ kun bshad rkang pa gnyis pa'i 'gor bshad pa'i san dang yin dang*/ kā mya dang*/ a yi dang*/ in kā ri ta dang*/ ya sgra dang*/ ā ya rnams byings la byin nas kyang da dung byings nyid du gnas pa ste/ de dag gi mthar de rnams byings so zhes bshad pas so/ /de yang kā ri ta'i phyed byings las kyang rgyu la'o zhes pa dang san ni/ byings nyid la ster bas nge gnyis la byings las gyur ba'i byings dang*/ gzhan rnams ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin no zhes ming la ster zhing kā ri ta'i phyed/ byings don la in te kā ri ta'o zhes pa ni ming byings su sgrub pas na ming las gyur pa'i byings te gnyis ka rkyen gyis bcos pa'o| |rang bzhin gnyis pa ming ni/ byings dang rnam dbye bor ba'i don dang ldan pa rtags so/ /zhes pas/ byings dang po gnyis gang rung la kṛt rkyen byin nas byings yin pa yang bor/ san sogs ma byin pas rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings kyang ma yin/ rnam dbye gnyis po ma byin pas tshig tu yang ma grub pa zhig yin la/ de la ming rkang dang por dngos su bstan pa/ ita uta agni'o/ /īta ūta bud med rjod pa dag na dī'o/ /ā shraddha'o/ /zhes/ a i thung ngu'i mtha' can agni'i rtags dang*/ ring po'i mtha' can bud med brjod na na dī'i rtags dang*| ā yig ring po'i mtha' can shraddhā'i rtags zhes pa gsum dang*/ a yig thung ngu'i mtha' can dang*/

ṛta mtha'i rtags zhes pa rnams bshad kyang*/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum/ de la'ang rtags gsum so so ba dang thun mong ba gnyis| dang po la skyes pa kho na'i rtags sogs gsum/ de re re la dbyangs mtha' can dang gsal byed mtha' can gnyis/ gnyis pa rtags gnyis thun mong ba dang gsum/ thun mong ba gnyis/ dang po la skyes pa'i rtags can gyi rtags gnyis pa sogs gsum/ gnyis pa la skyes pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gsum pa sogs gsum ste rgyas par si sogs kyi bya ba rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung las 'byung ba spyi don du yang rags pa bris pa bzhin no/ /rkyen ni/ rang bzhin rnam 'gyur du sgrub par byed pa'i sgra'i yan lag yin la dbye na rnam dbye yang rkyen du bsdus nas/ byings rtags su dang*/ byings tshig tu dang*/ byings byings su dang*/ rtags rtags su dang*/ ming ming du dang*/ rtags byings su dang rtags tshig tu sgrub par byed pa'i rkyen te bdun no/ /mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin/ /kṛta dang*/ ti sogs dang*/ san dang*/ mo rtags dang*/ de phan dang*/ yin sogs dang*/ si sogs rnams yin no/ /dang po ni/ kṛta le rkang pa drug dang*/ de'i cha shas u ṇa rkang pa gsum mo/ /de dag kyang brjod bya ngo bo dang las dang byed pa po la 'jug pa sogs te rgyas par gzhung du gsal lo/ /gnyis pa la ti sogs dngos dang*/ de dang 'brel ba gnyis te/ dang po la brta mā na sogs sde tshan bcu'i don ston byed ni/ 'dod pa dang smon pa dang nus pa'i don la pañtsa mī dang*/ sgrub pa sogs la sapta mī dang*/ bye brag tu bya ba yang dag par sdud pa rnams la pañtsa mī'i dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi nyid 'jug dgag pa'i mā byings kyi sngon du sbyor ba la adya tā nī dang*/ māsma sbyor ba la de dang hyasta nī yang 'jug go /gzhan rnams ni dus la 'jug ste/ brta mā ni na spyir da ltar ba/ tasmra zhes sogs sma dang sbyar na 'das pa/ hyasta nī ni kha sang*/

adya ta nī ni sngon ma/ pa ro3kṣā ni lkog gyur/ shwasta nī ni nang par/ ā shi ṣa ni smon pa/ bha bi ṣyanti ni 'byung 'gyur kṛ patti ni bya ba shor ba'am thal ba'i ming yin pas rang ming gis dus dang don gyi khyad par go bar gsungs so/ /de dang 'brel pa ni| sde tshan dang po bzhi la byings thams cad pa zer la/ de rnams la byings so so'i dbang gis/ aṇa bi ka ra ṇa dang san bi ka ra ṇa dang*/ de bzhin du nu dang*/ u sogs bi ka ra ṇa rnams kyang byings mtha' yin pa ltar bshad kyang don rkyen gyi cha shas yin pas ti sogs dang 'brel ba'i rkyen du bsdu bar bya zhing*/ byings thams cad pa ma yin pa'i ba ro3kṣā la byings dang rkyen gyi bar du āṃ dang*/ de'i dbang gis kri3 dang*/ a dya ta nī ya si tsa dang*/ saṇa dang tsaṇa dang aṇa la itsa sogs rnams so/ / gsum pa ni/ kun bshad rkang pa gnyis pa'i thog mar bshad pa'i san yin te/ de yang byings nyid kyi mthar dang*/ kṛta rkyen du ma zhes pa byings byin na tum mtha'i byings zhes zer la de'i mthar san nges par ster bar gsungs te/ der byin na'ang byings nyid du gnas pa'o/ bzhi pa ni/ dpang los mo rtags don du dī ī sogs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byings la kṛta byin nas rtags su grub pa mo'i rtags su bya ba'i phyir du/ bud med la a las ā pa'o zhes sogs dang ka lā par ī dang tsand+ra par dī'i nga rjes 'brel du byas pa lta bu mo rtags su grags pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ de phan gyi rkyen tsand+ra par shin tu rgyas pa dang ka lā par mdor bsdus pa bshad pa rnams te/ rnam 'grel du/ de la phan pa'am byed ldan nam/ / zhes pa'i de phan no/ /byed ldan ni 'gyur thal ba ste/ de la phan pa'am kṛ ta'o// zhes pa kṛta rkyen ston no/ de yang de'i bu/ des btsos/ des rdzogs zhes sogs la| bu dang btsos pa sogs kyi skad dod med kyang rkyen gyi nus pas de dang de ston par nus pa zhig go

/rkyen de'i mthar ni phal cher si sogs kyi rnam dbye 'jug la/ de phan nyid la/ lnga pa la tas so/ /bdun pa la tra'o zhes sogs de phan nyid rnam dbyer song ba'ang yod de/ la tra zhes pa gang du zhes sogs ston pa lta bu'o/ / drug pa ni/ kun bshad gnyis par/ ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin no zhes sogs/ yin sogs kyi rkyen no/ /bdun pa ni/ rnam dbye ste/ bi bha ga zhes pa don rnam par 'byed pa'o/ / dbye na si sogs nyi shu rtsa gcig ti sogs brgya dang brgyad cu/ de phan gyi rnam dbye dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa rnam 'gyur ni/ dpang los/ rang bzhin rkyen dang 'brel ba'am/ /yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba yi/ /sgyur dang dbyi ba rnam 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgra'i yan lag gi yi ge sgyur ba'am dbyi ba gang rung gis yi ge'i lus 'gyur ba ni rnam 'gyur gyi ngo bo yin la/ dbye na yan lag so so ba'i dang phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur gnyis yin la/ dang po ni sbyar ba min pa dang ā ga ma'o/ /dang po ni rjes 'brel du grags pa ste/ de yang gang rjes su 'brel ba mi sbyor ro/ /zhes pa ltar sgra de'i cha shas su dang por byung yang de dang lhan cig mi gnas pa ste/ de la dbye na rjes 'brel tsam dang*/ brjod don dang ngo bo'i don gyi rjes 'brel te gsum du bdag gi bla ma bzhed la/ dang po la dbye na drug byings dang rkyen dang*/ rtags dang ā ga ma dang*/ mi zad pa dang*/ tshig gi rjes 'brel lo/ /dang po la bzhi/ dbyangs dang*/ gsal byed dang*/ gsal byed srog yig can dang dbyangs gsal gnyis ka rjes 'brel lo/ /dang po la dgu dang*| gnyis pa la brgyad dang*/ gsum pa la nyi/ ṭu/ ḍu/ nyā dang*/ bzhi pa ni i ra rjes 'brel lo/ /gnyis pa rkyen gyi rjes 'brel la/ gṛta dang*/ mo rtags dang*/ de phan dang*/ si sogs dang*/ san sogs dang*/ ti sogs dang de dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po la dbyangs ni/ ṛ dang*/ kwi pa kyi i lta bu'o/

/gsal byed ni ka sogs bcu bzhi tsam mo/ /mo rtags la/ pa dang nga'o// de phan la/ ta/ ṭa| ḍa/ ṇa rnams so/ /si sogs la/ i/ nga/ ṭa/ dza/ pa/ sha rnams so/ / san sogs la/ na/ in/ i kā ri ta'i na rnams so/ /ti sogs la/ di si 'i i dang*/ a ṭa'i ṭa dang*/ thal gyi la rnams so/ /de dang 'brel pa la/ a/ tsa/ ṇa/ na rnams so/ /rtags kyi rjes 'brel ni ta'o/ /ā ga ma'i ni u dang ṭa'o/ / tshig gi rjes 'brel yang ta'o/ /rjod don gyi rjes 'brel ni/ a/ i/ u/ in/ un rnams so/ /ngo bo'i don gyi rjes 'brel ni/ tsand+ra par/ rang gi ngo bo la i ki shī pa rnams so/ /des ni 'dis zlas drangs pa'i rjes 'brel tsam po thams cad la khyad par gyi don gyi rjes 'brel zhes bya'o/ /ā ga ma nī/ ngo bo gong du bshad pa ltar te/ rtags kyi don du dgos pa khyad par ba yod kyang gar yod dang nam 'ong gi gnas dus ma nges pas sgra'i yi ge rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du sgyur byed do/ / gnyis pa phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur la/ spyir dang*/ byings rkyen dang*/ tshig phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ mtshams sbyor rkang pa gnyis pa gsum pa'i bstan don rnams sa| |gnyis pa yang byings dang rkyen spyir phrad pas ni/ byings kyi yon tan/ i e dang*/ u o dang*/ ṛ ar dang*/ l̥ al du 'gyur ba rnams te/ de ltar sgyur nus kyi rkyen ni gtso bor kṛta rkyen gyi nang nas ka nga rjes 'brel la yon tan bkag pas de gnyis rjes 'brel du med pa'i rkyen rnams so/ /bye brag tu phrad pas na/ gtso bor kun bshad kyi dbang du byas nas/ byings kyi lus 'gyur ni/ rkang pa bdun pa yan gyis bstan pa rnams so/ /rkyen gyi lus 'gyur ni/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstan pa rnams so/ /byings dang kṛta rkyen phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ kṛta rkang pa dang por bstan pa rnams byings dang*/ drug pa'i smad nas bstan pa rnams rkyen gyi lus 'gyur gtso che'o/

/de bzhin du rtags dang rnam dbye phrad pa la yang*/ rnam dbye la brten pa'i rtags kyi dang*/ rtags la brten pa'i rnam dbye'i dang*/ gnyis ka la brten pa'i gnyis ka'i lus 'gyur rgyas pa ming rkang dang po bzhis rgyas par bstan pa rnams so/ /rtags dang rtags phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni mo rtags la brten pa rnams so/ /ming dang ming phrad pa ni/ de phan gyi rkyen la brten pa rnams so/ /tshig phan tshun phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ sde pa'i dang po tshig mtha' rnams dbyangs dang sgra ldan rnams la gsum pa rnams so/ /zhes mtshams sbyor bzhi pas bstan pa kun dang*/ tshig mthar eta ota las pha rol gyi a yig dbyi'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rnam par gcad bya tsa'am tsa la sha'o zhes sogs mtshams sbyor lnga pas bstan pa rnams dang*/ tshig sdud kyi lus 'gyur ji snyed bshad pa sogs so/ / bzhi pa ni/ de ltar rnam 'gyur gyi dbye ba sogs sgra'i yan lag mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ 'dir cung zad bshad pa rnams deng sang rgyug che bar snang bas ka lā pa'i brda chad kyi steng nas mdor bsdus brjod pa tsam du zad pas/ tsand+ra pa la sogs pa'i legs sbyar gyi gzhung lugs chen po rtsa 'grel rnams su bslab cing*| rjes 'brel phyid pa'i mdo la sogs pa rgyas par ni/ kho bos ka lā pa'i spyi don du gsal ba der blta bar bya'o/ /rig gnas kun shes kyi le'u bzhi pa cung zad bshad pa'o// // lnga pa tshad ma'am gtan tshigs rigs pa'i gnas bshad pa la'ang*/ dgos pa/ byung tshul/ rang bzhin/ kha 'phangs dang bzhi'o/ dang po ni/ shes bya ji snyed pa phung khams skye mched kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la sgro skur sel ba ni gzhung 'dir rgyas par mi 'byung la/ ji snyed pa mi rtag pa dang stong bdag med la sogs pa la 'khrul pa sel ba yang dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo min kyang rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug dang*/ rang bzhin rtags kyi khyab 'brel la dogs pa spong ba'i gzhan sel gyis spyi rtag dngos rgya cher bkag cing*/

ldog khyab gnod pa can gyis 'dus byas rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par sdod mi srid pa dngos su grub par spyir rtag 'dzin dang*/ khyad par rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag shugs la khegs/ mngon sum le'u'i mngon sum gyis yul 'dzin tshul las 'phros nas gzung 'dzin gyi chos bdag bkag go /gzhan yang rang blo lkog gyur du 'dod pa'i log rtog dang*/ blo la tshul gnyis dang rang rig mi 'dod pa sogs kyi log smra tshar bcad cing*/ dngos bstan la med pa'i shes bya ji snyed kyi gnas la log par rtog pa'i smra ngan thams cad/ thal 'gyur gyi tshar gcod tshul dang sgrub ngag gis rjes su 'dzin tshul rgya cher dngos su bstan pas zlog par nus pa'i phyir log smra tshar gcod kyi rig gnas mchog tu grub bo/ /gnyis pa la rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ mkhas pas bkral tshul bod du byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i mjug tu/ da lta'i dngos ston bstod pa ni/ /de yi bstan pa nyid las ni/ /tshad ma'i de nyid grub don te// rjes su dpag pa ma bzlog phyir/ /cung zad skye ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gang de thams cad 'gag chos can/ /zhes sogs rnam pa du mar ni/ /de yi sbyor ba mthong phyir ro/ /med na mi 'byung mtshan nyid can/ /rtags ni rjes dpag rten yin no/ /bsgrub byas gtan tshigs khyab pa ni/ /bstan phyir de yang gsal bar bshad| |ces pas tshad ma mdor ston pa la tshad mar gyur pa de lta bu'i dngos por bstan nas bstod pa ni/ tshad ma'i mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid mi slu ba'i de kho na nyid thams cad phyogs glang gi rang bzo ma yin gyi/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab nyid las gsal bar 'byung ngo zhes gus pa skyed pa'i ched du yin la/ de yang mngon sum ni rtogs sla bas log rtog gi gnas med mod/ rjes su dpag pa ni rtogs dka' ba'i gzhal bya'i gtso bo rtogs pa'i thabs yin mod kyang rgyal bas ma gsungs sam snyam pa bzlog phyir du gsungs tshul gsal bar bstan

no| |mngon sum bzhi ga dang*/ rjes dpag thams cad kyi rten gtan tshigs gsum ka mdo las bstan tshul ni gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba nyid kyis shin tu gsal lo| |de yang mngon sum bzhi'i ya gyal gyi yid mngon ni/ dbang shes kyi bdag rkyen las dngos su skyes pa nyid du mdos kyang bstan pas/ skye mched drug pa chos kyi gsal snang yod pa tsam la yid mngon du byas na/ rang rig dang rnal 'byor mngon sum yang der 'gyur zhing*/ /yid dang mngon sum gyi gzhi mthun yin pa tsam gyis der byas na dbang mngon yang der thal te/ lus ngag yid gsum du phye ba'i yid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas brgyud de/ mngon pa sde bdun gyi nang tshan bstan bcos rab tu byed pa mdzad pa po'i dgra bcom dbyig sogs dang dus dang mkhas mthong sogs mnyam zhing*/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms mdzad pa po'i dgra bcom chos skyob dang*/ des paṇa chen me waṃ ga dang des mkhas mchod dbyig gnyen la brgyud par tshad ma ba rnams la grags so/ /tshad ma'i rig pa'i gtso bo rnams ni mdzod 'grel na shin tu gsal zhing*/ des ni/ kha che'i mkhas pa dge 'dun bzang po'am 'dus pa bzang po la gsan la/ des ni/ 'ong srungs nye 'khor kun dga' sha gos can/ /nyer sbas dhi dhi nag po legs mthong blo/ /zhes bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun du grags pa'i tha ma phyir mi 'ongs blos mi 'bebs la gsan pa nas brgyud kyang rung ngo*/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pas ni tshad ma'i bstan bcos rtsod sgrub tu grags pa mdzad kyang gzhon nu blo gros ma smin pa'i dus su mdzad pas/ bshad pa 'ga' zhig snying po med par dgongs so zhes kun btus su dgag pa yang 'ga' re mdzad do/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa la ni rang las mkhas pa'i slob ma bzhir grags te/ phar phyin dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa rnams rang las mkhas pa ni rim bzhin/ 'phags pa grol sde dang*/ phyogs glang dang*/

yon tan 'od dang*/ blo brtan rnams so/ /'dir phyogs kyi glang po ni/ rang sde gnas ma bu pa'i nang du rab tu byung ste brjod du med pa'i bdag la dgag pa'i rnam pa cung zad byas pas ma mthun nas rgya gar lho phyogs su kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i zhabs pad legs par bsten/ sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' la legs par sbyang*/ brgyad stong don bsdu rtsa 'grel la sogs pa theg chen gyi bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ khyad par gtan tshigs rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi thog mar gyur te/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu ba mang du mdzad/ phyis rgya gar byang phyogs ri bo 'bigs byed kyi phyogs glang phug par de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshad ma mdo rtsom par bzhed nas/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshad ma bsgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las/ /btus nas sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad thod le kor gyis phug pa'i sgo gong du bris pas/ mu stegs kun gyi byin pa rengs/ sa g.yos pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung ba mu stegs kyis ma bzod pas/ ston pa thub rgyal nag pos lan gnyis lan gsum du bsubs pas/ rtsod par nus na lus dngos su ston/ mi nus na thod le kor gyi ri mo bsubs par nus kyang blo gros kyi ri mo bsub par mi nus so zhes bris pas lus dngos su bstan nas/ brtsad pa'i rig pas lan du mar tshar bcad kyang rdzu 'phrul dang g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyis 'pham pa'i ngos len ma byung zhing 'dul bar ma nus pas thugs phyung nas/ thod le kor nam mkhar 'phangs nas 'di sa la lhung ba na byang chub kyi sems gtong zhes dam bcas pas yun ring du sa la ma lhung*/ bltas pas bar snang na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mngon sum du bzhugs nas/ bu/ dman pa'i sems ma bskyed cig rdzogs byang gi bar du kho bos rjes su gzung ngo*/

/bstan bcos de yang legs par rtsoms shig 'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes snang ba byin te/ rnam nges kyi 'gor/ gang la 'phags pa nyid rjes bzung ba de ni dpal ldan dri med blo mnga' ste/ /zhes so/ /bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams tshul gzhung du gsal la/ dgongs pa ma rnyed bzhin du brtsams pa'i 'grel byaid 'ga' yang byung zhing khyad par dngos slob slob dpon dbang phyug sdes bshad srol ma nyams tsam mdzad pa'i drung du/ phyi rol mu stegs kyi bram ze'i rigs la sgra tshad byang zhing*/ khyad par rtog ge'i gsang tshig la mkhas par sbyangs ba zhig nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs te/ mdo sngags du ma'i lung rigs dang man ngag gi sgo nas 'khor lo bde mchog gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas kun btus tshar gsum gsan pas bshad srol rnams phyogs glang gi dgongs pa min par rtogs te/ slob dpon gyis kyang de lta na kho bo phyogs sngar byas pa'i bstan bcos rtsoms shig ces gnang ba thob nas tshad ma sde bdun mdzad| ji ltar mdzad tshul ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ /tshad ma'i gzhung 'grel phal cher la bam grangs sogs kyi gzhung tshad ma mdzad kyang*/ le'u dang po'i rang 'grel la stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa zhes gsal bar grags so/ /'di slob dpon rgyan mkhan po rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni/ rjes dpag shin tu dka' bas 'grel pa byas pa yin gyi/ le'u'i go rim ni mdo dang bstun dgos pas mchod brjod kyi 'grel pa tshad ma grub pa ni le'u dang por byas nas de rjes mngon sum dang*/ de rjes rang don dang gzhan gyi rjes dpag rim pa bzhin yin pas lha shāka ni le'u'i go rim tsam la yang 'khrul zhes zer yang*/ rang 'grel nyid kyi thog mar/ don dang don min pa rnam par 'byed pa ni rjes su dpag pa la rag las zhes gsungs la don bstan pa skyon med dang*/ don min skyon can rnam par 'byed pa ste so sor shes pa dang*/

de ston pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa yang rjes dpag la rag las zhes pas rjes dpag bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyur bstan pa'i phyir le'u dang por rig pas lha shāka gi bzhed pa nyid rgya dpe bod dpe kun la grags pa ni legs pa yin la/ /rang 'grel 'di la bram ze chen po shad dkar nandas mthong ba blos slad man la 'grel bshad ma mdzad pas/ de man chad rang 'grel min zer mkhan rgya gar du yang byung mod/ de lta na de min gyi le'u dang po la 'grel pa 'thad ldan med par 'gyur la/ shākya blos kyang 'grel rdzus la 'grel bshad byas par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyan gyi rjes 'brang sogs tshad ma'i gzhung che chung gong du brjod zin rnams dang bcas pa gzhung phran du ma bstan 'gyur dkar chag tu gsal ba mang po yod pa rnams las/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rigs thigs dang gtan tshigs thigs pa la sogs pa'i sde bdun phyi ma 'ga' zhig dul lha sogs kyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'gyur yod kyang*/ mdo dang rnam 'grel rnam nges 'grel chen dang bcas pa ni phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba rma dge blo sogs kyis thog mar bsgyur cing phal cher ni rngog lo chen pos gsar bsgyur dang 'gyur bcos du ma mdzad nas 'chang nyan gyis rgyas par gtan la phab mod/ rnam 'grel ni rnam nges la ltos te bshad srol ma nub tsam du gnas pa las/ dus phyis chos rje sa paṇa gyis rtsal du bton nas bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ 'phags pas gsang phur rnam 'grel gyi tshad rgyags sbyar/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sku mched kyis kyang rtsal du bton pas shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /rang bzhin la/ gzhal bya mngon gyur/ lkog gyur/ shin tu lkog gyur gsum gyi dang po la/ gzhal bya dang*| de 'jal byed ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung de dag gi brjod bya ni| gong du bshad pa ltar/ rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad dang*/ de bsdu na rang gi gzhal bya rtogs pa'i thabs dang*/

rtogs nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs zhes pa gnyis su'ang 'du zhing*/ gzhung gzhan du rtog ge'i tshig don bcu drug tu'ang grags mod kyi/ gtan la dbab bya gzhal bya'i gnas gsum du 'du ste/ de rnams kyi 'jal byed tshad ma dang ston byed thal rang gi ngag kyang gzhal bya gsum du 'dus shing gzhal bya bshad pa na 'jal byed dang ston byed kyang don gyis 'phangs yod pas 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de la gzhal bya mngon gyur ni| tshur mthong gi dbang du byas phyi rol gzhan rig mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i tshul gyis myong stobs kyis sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i skye mched lnga dang*/ rang rig tshad mas myong zhing rig pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa shes pa'i steng gi myong bya tsam du zad pas rnam shes tshogs drug gi skye mched dang*/ chos kyi skye mched kyi phyogs gcig sems byung rnams kyi myong rig gi cha'o/ /des na don dam rig pas dpyad bzod du grub pa yang de dag tu zad de/ lha dbang blos rang rig mngon sum gyi skabs su gtso bo 'gog pa'i tshe/ gzugs dang bde ba la sogs pa bzhin du don dam du grub pa zhig gam/ chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa bzhin du kun rdzob tu grub pa zhig yin zhes dpyad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mdzod du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ / zhes pa dang gcig pas/ 'di bye smra'i bden gnyis dang*/ dngos po la bden grub kyis khyab pa mdo sde pa'i lugs su rlung ltar grags shing thams cad the tshom med par khas len pa ni/ mdo sde pa la skur ba shin tu chen po yin te/ gzhan du yang bshad zin no/ /'phags pa la ni/ bden bzhi mi rtag bcu drug sogs pa bdag med kyi gnas lugs gzhal bya mngon gyur yin par thams cad 'dod mod| 'on kyang rtog ge'i dbang phyug gi bzhed pa ni/
