med dgag mngon sum la dngos su mi snang bas dgag byas stong pa'i dgag gzhi rang mtshan dngos su rtogs pas de'i steng gi med dgag shugs la rtogs pas na/ gcig dmigs nyams su myong ba las/ /'di ni dmigs so zhes bya'am/ /ma dmigs so zhes rtogs can gyi/ /blo ni gnyis su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rtogs bya'i gtso bo med dgag ni shugs la rtogs pas rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi phyogs chos mngon sum gyis grub pa dang 'dir yang 'dra bar bzhed de/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pas/ /'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ / rgyu yin de yi gcod byed ni/ /bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba yin/ /zhes spang bya'i rgyu bdag 'dzin ni 'dus byas phung po'i spyod yul can yin la/ de dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni dmigs yul gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa 'dzin stangs 'gal bar skye dgos pas bdag gis stong pa'i phung po dag pa ba la dngos su dmigs pas de yi steng gi bdag med ni yul gyi gtso bo yin kyang shugs la rtogs pa don smra'i lugs dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi gzhan dbang dngos su rtogs pas de'i steng gi gnyis stong med dgag tu gyur pa'i 'gyur med yongs grub shugs la rtogs pa ni rnam rig pa'i lugs su bzhed par mngon no/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa las log pa ni thams cad du med pa go bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes rnam nges su gsungs pa'i don du byas nas shes bya ji snyed dbang po gzugs can lnga dang ldan min 'du byed dang 'dus ma byas gsum la sogs pa'ang mngon gyur yin no zhes bod kyi mkhas mang mgrin gcig tu smra mod kyi/ dpal chos kyi grags pas ni/ shes bya ji lta ba bdag med gnas lugs ni/ yul dngos stobs rig pas 'grub cing de la goms na gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa 'byung ba yang dngos stobs kyis grub pas ji lta ba mkhyen tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/

ji snyed pa'i mkhyen tshul ni/ spyir/ 'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa/ /nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho med/ /ces dang*/ gal te ring mthong tshad yin na/ /tshul shog bya rgod bsten par gyis/ /zhes grol ba don gnyer la mi mkho ba dang*/ mkho yang*/ rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab/ / ces dang*/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi don thams cad thugs su chud pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste shes pa dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ 'grel par tha mal pa gnyid du song bas rang gi rtsa na gnas pa'i gnyid ma log pa'i gang zag gi rgyud tshod mi shes pa dper byas nas bshad do/ /mdzod 'grel dgu par ni/ mes nags thams cad rim gyis bsregs nas mthar ma lus na/ mes nags thams cad bsregs zhes pa ltar/ rgyun gyis rim gyis mkhyen pa la thams cad mkhyen zhes bzhag par gsungs pa sogs bshad tshul mang bas bsam gyis mi khyab bo| |'on kyang sangs rgyas la lkog gyur du song ba ni mi srid la/

shugs la rtogs pa yod par skabs 'di rnams su khas blang ngo*/ /ka bum sogs ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ /gal te zlog phyir ro zhes pa ma grub ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gal te dngos rnams de nyid du med na/ /tha snyad du yang mo gsham bu ji bzhin| |'di dag med pa nyid 'gyur de yi phyir/ /'di dag rang bzhin gyis ni yod pa yin/ /zhes pa phyogs snga'i gzhung yin la/ rang bzhin gyi dngos por smra ba thams cad/ yod na rang bzhin gyis yod pa dang*/ bden par med na gtan med du 'dod pa kho na yin gyi/ don dam par ma grub kyang tha snyad yod pa'i rnam gzhag ni dbu ma pa las gzhan gyis 'jog mi shes so zhes pa 'di bod snga phyi la rlung ltar grags pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ grags pa ni bden mod/ shin tu mi rigs te| mu stegs grangs can pa yang*/ yon tan rnams kyi rang bzhin mchog/ snang ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /snang ba'i lam du gang gyur pa/ /de ni sgyu ma bzhin du gsob/ /ces/ rang bzhin gtso bo dang bdag shes rig ni rtag dngos rig pas dpyod pa yin kyang tha mal ba la mi snang*/ da ltar snang ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'di ni rang stong gsog gsob rdzun pa slu chos yin no zhes zer zhing*/ rnam 'gyur med par khas mi len la/ bdag shes rig gi cha bde gshegs snying po la byas nas gzhan 'di dang mthun par kun rdzob rang stong du smra ba bod na'ang yod cing*/ gnyis stong gi shes rig bden grub don dam bden pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad rab rib can gyi skra shad ltar sems tsam rnam rdzun pas kyang 'dod la| snang ba med par mi 'dod par/ /rnam rig de bzhin min rnam pa/ /skye 'gyur rab rib la sogs bzhin/ /zhes gnyis snang gi bag chags las skye bar 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ 'jug pa nyid du/ bum sogs 'di dag de nyid du med kyang*| |'jig rten rab tu grags par yod ji bzhin/ /zhes/ bum pa bden grub ma yin par dngos smra rang gis khas blangs pa dper bkod pa'i phyir dang*/

rang sde dma' shos mthar thug gnas ma bu pas kyang*/ gal te khyod bum dngos por ma grub pa'i/ /ngo bos gzugs sogs las brjod med 'dod ltar/ / bdag gang phung po las brjod med gyur na/ /rang gi ngo bos yod par rtogs mi bya| |zhes/ bum pa blo chos btags yod du 'dod pa ltar bdag kyang de bzhin 'dod par gyis shig ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhal bya mngon gyur 'di'i 'jal byed mngon sum ni mngon sum bzhi ste/ dbang po'i dang*/ yid kyi dang*/ rang rig dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum mo/ /gnyis pa lkog gyur ni/ dbang po gzugs can rnams dang*/ bden bzhi'i mi rtag pa dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ bdag gi bas stong pa dang*| bdag med pa sogs rnam pa bcu drug po rnams dang*/ des mtshon pa'i gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med dang*/bdag gcig dang de byung gi 'brel pa dang*/ rgyu'am nus pa dang*/ sems kyi steng gi kun byang gi sa bon dag spang gnyen gyi bya byed la sogs pa ni/ gzhal bya gnyis pa lkog gyur yin te| dngos po stobs shugs kyi gtan tshigs kho nas sgrub dgos pa'i phyir te/ de gzhal bya gang zag gi mngon sum gyis mi 'grub cing khungs rnam dag la ltos mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhal bya 'di'i 'jal byed dang sgrub byed dngos stobs rjes dpag gi rten gtan tshigs de ni rnam pa gsum ste/ 'bras bu'i dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dang*/ ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs zhes bya'o/ /'bras rtags ni/ mthun dpe khang nang gi tshang mang du me du'i rgyu 'bras nges byed dang por me du gnyis ka ma dmigs/ de nas me dmigs/ de nas du ba dmigs pa'i phrugs gsum dang*/ de nas du ba dmigs pa'i rjes su me ma dmigs/ de nas du ba yang ma dmigs pa ste/ ma dmigs pa sngon du 'gro ba gsum rjes 'gro ba dang*/ de nas dmigs pa sngon du 'gro ba gsum ldog pa nges byed yin pas drug ltar snang*|

yang rjes su 'gro ldog phrugs gcig pas gsum du bsdus pa las me du gnyis rgyu 'bras der nges pa'i rjes su/ la khar sogs te/ rtags 'dzin sems kyis bsgrub bya la rgyab na me yod par nges pa'i rjes dpag bskyaid pa dngos bstan du mdzad nas 'bras rtags kyi rnam gzhag gzhung du bstan pas ni/ spyir rgyu 'bras su nges pa'i tshig dang don nam lung rtogs kyi 'bras bu ni rang rgyud la mngon sum du grub pa'i rtags las/ rang gi rgyu gsal bar rtogs nas du ba 'dod pas me la 'bad dgos pa ltar/ 'bras bu de rdzogs par 'dod pas rgyu la 'bad dgos pa/ 'grub pas 'bras rtags bshad pa yang phugs kyi don chen po dang ldan no/ /de bzhin du rnam shes la bdag rkyen dbang po yod par yang*/ dbang shes spyir skye/ dmigs rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen yod kyang mi skye res 'ga' skye bar mngon pa'i rgyu'i byed par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags kyis sgrub pa sogs rkyen gzhan gnyis la'ang sbyor ro/ /gzhan ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ rgyas par tshad ma'i bstan bcos las rtogs par bya'o/ /rang bzhin gyi rtags ni/ sgra sogs sogs te/ rtags 'di la rang bzhin ltos pa ba dang*/ dag pa ba gnyis su gsungs zhes pa'i bar rgyas par bshad na shin tu mang la/ mdor bsdus ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ /ma dmigs pa'i rtags la rigs gnyis te/ mi snang ba ma dmigs pa dang*/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'o/ /de yang*/ rnam 'grel du| tshad ma rnams ni mi 'jug pa/ /med la mi 'jug 'bras bu can/ /gtan tshigs bye brag la ltos nas/ /'ga' zhig med shes 'bras bu can/ /zhes pas bstan te/ dang po ni/ bsgrub bya de gang zag de'i tshad mas med par yang ma nges/ mngon sum dang lung sogs rtags kyis yod par yang mi 'grub pa'i shin tu lkog gyur bskal don de ltar gyur bas yod nges kyi tha snyad don mthun mi 'jug pa ste/ spyi yod srid kyang gang zag de'i mngon rjes tshad mas yod med gang du yang ma grub pa'i phyir ro/

/de yang snang du rung bzhin du ma dmigs na med par 'grub kyang gang zag de la bskal don du song bas snang du mi rung nas ma dmigs pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni sogs te/ gzhan rgyud kyi skyon yon khyad par ba kha tshon gcod pa ni/ mdo dang bstan bcos spyi dang*/ khyad par rgyud gzhan grub par yang yang bkag ste/ lus ngag gi rig byed las de kun nas slong ba'i shes rig yod par nges kyis dad sdang sogs kyi khyad par la ni 'khrul par lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa snang rung ma dmigs pa gzhung du gsungs pa ni/ snang rung bum pas dben pa'i gzhir bum pa med de/ de snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs kyi phyogs chos dang khyab pa nges byed rnam 'grel du yang skabs 'gar gsungs la/ rnam nges/ rig thigs| gtan tshigs thigs pa/ rtsod rig rnams su ni 'di kho na la rtsal du bton pa ltar gsungs te/ 'dir rgyas par bris na/ gang zag thun mong ba mang pos mi go bas gzhung de rnams dang kho bos byas pa'i de dag gi rnam bshad na gsal lo/ /rtags 'di rgya cher bshad pa'i gtso bo'i dgos pa ni/ mu stegs kun gyis phung po las don gzhan du rang skya thub pa'i gang zag gi bdag 'dod pas de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis 'gog pa'i ched kho na ste/ rgyal ba byams pas kyang*/ gang zag brtags par yod nyid du/ /brjod bya rdzas yod ma yin no/ /mi dmigs phyin ci log pa dang*/ /kun nas nyon mongs nyon mongs rgyu| |zhes sogs rgyas par dang mdzod 'grel dgu par shin tu yang rgyas par ro| |'di yi phyogs chos kyang mngon sum gyis grub ste/ phung po dag pa ba dngos su dmigs pa'i mngon sum gyi byed pas bdag snang rung ma dmigs pa grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags 'di la rtsa ba'i dbye ba 'brel zla ma dmigs pa dang 'gal zla dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po la rang bzhin dang khyab byed dang rgyu dang dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa de bzhi dang*/

gnyis pa la yang rang bzhin 'gal dmigs sogs kyi dbye ba rgyas par rig pa'i gzhung las tsha reg grang reg sogs la sbyar nas gsungs pa rnams/ bdag 'dzin dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs la legs par sbyar nas shes par bya ba'i ched de/ kha cig rma sogs phyir na skyon/ /zad min zhes zer 'di ldog la/ /the tshom za ba de phyir 'khrul/ /rtag nyid phyir rim thabs med phyir/ /yang na thabs ni mi shes phyir/ /skyon rnams mi zad pa nyid ces/ /bya bar yongs su rtog drang na/ /rgyu yod phyir na rgyu yi ni| |gnyen po goms pas zad phyir dang*/ /rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ lung dang rig pas rnam dpyod pa/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyi khyad par gyis/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de mi rtag /la sogs rang bzhin rtogs par mdzad/ /gang phyir de ltar rgyu gnas na/ /'bras log gzigs pa med phyir ro/ /de rgyu gzhom phyir de yi ni/ /mi mthun phyogs la rtog par mdzad/ /rgyu yi ngo bo rtogs pa'i phyir/ /de min mthun phyogs kyang nges 'gyur| |bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams go ba la shin tu phan pas/ rig pa'i gzhung la ma sbyangs par bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab skyed par 'dod pa rnams ni cher 'khrul lo/ /gsum pa shin tu lkog gyur ni/ dge sdig sogs/ mngon sum dang dngos stobs kyi gtan tshigs gnyis kas mi 'grub par lung tsam la brten nas rtogs dgos pa'i gzhal bya ste/ lung yang dpyad gsum gyis ma dag pa ni log phyogs ston pa'i lung yang yod pas nges pa'i gegs byed tsam du zad la/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'am| yid ches nyes zad kyi dgongs gzhi dgos pa sogs med pa'i nges don gyi tshig ni/ brjod bya'i zlog phyaugs la gnod byed nyid du nges mod/ rnam nges su ni| lung gegs byed kyi phyogs nyid gtso bor gsungs te gzhan du blta'o/

/ bzhi pa ni/ rig gnas 'di'i brjod bya rgyas pa de dag sogs bya'o/ / rig gnas bzhi pa cung zad bshad pa'o// // lnga pa rig gnas kyi gtso bo rgyal ba'i bstan pa nang rig pa bshad pa la yang*/ brjod bya bsdus te bstan pa dang*/ rjod byed rgyas par bshad/ rgyas par gzhan du kha 'phangs pa'o/ / dang po ni/ 'og sa las zhi rags kyi sgo nas ci yang med man chad las 'dod chags dang bral zhing nges par 'byung ba ni/ phyi rol pa la'ang yod mod sa dgu mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba med la/ de yang bden pa'i rnam pa can gyi lam gyis spang bya'i sa bon 'joms pa med cing*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ni/ sa mtha' dag las dang spang bya'i sa bon las nges par 'byung bas na nges 'byung mchog ste/ 'di kho nas kyang bstan pa dang*/ de ston byed la dad pa rkang gi khongs nas ci'i phyir mi skye soms shigakhyad par/ gang zag gi sems rgyud la thog mar chung ngu'i chung ngu tsam skyes na yang*/ bzhi brgya par/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems dang po/ /sa steng skye bo thams cad ni/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal nyid gyur pa/ /de dag bsod nams las khyad 'phags/ / zhes dang*/ mdo las/ nyan rang gi dgra bcom pa ches mchog tu gyur pa shin tu mang po bsdoms pa'i bsod nams kyis kyang byang sems sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi cha tsam la'ang bsgrun du med par lan mang du gsungs shing*/ spyod 'jug las/ sems can de dag rnams la sngon/ /rmi lam du yang 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rang gi don du'ang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas na kho bos/ dman pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang yang*/ /bya bar dka' zhing rmi lam tsam du yang*/ /skyed ma myong ba'i lhag bsam byang chub sems/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog de rnyed par shog /ces shin tu smon pa'i gnas su byas pa dngos bstan kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ 'jug par slob pa'i bcu dang sangs rgyas kyi bcu gcig pa ste don dam sems bskyed bcu gcig gsungs pa sogs ni kun la thun mong du grags pa'i gsung rab kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dang*/

rnam grol gsum zhes pa yang*/ thun mong la grags pa'i nyan rang theg chen gyi thar pa'am myang 'das gsum yang yin la/ thun mong min pa rdo rje theg pa yang bsnan pa'i gsung rab yongs rdzogs kyi rnam grol la yang rgya bod mang po na/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi don/ mdo sngags la nye ring dang thabs la mkhas mi mkhas sogs kyi khyad par yod kyi/ 'bras bu'i rnam grol khyad par med do zhes gsungs shing*/ phyis kyi mkhas pas/ gsang sngags ma bsnan na/ phar phyin theg pa rkyang pa la sangs rgyas med de/ phar phyin theg par gsungs pa'i spang bya mthar thug rgyun mtha'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo de spong bar mi nus pas sngags lam snon la/ de yang lam 'og ma'i dod thub phar phyin theg pa la yod pas sngags kyi mthong lam nas son zhing*/ bsnan pas thob pa'i rnam grol ni phar phyin theg par bshad pa'i sangs rgyas las lhag rgyu med do zhes bya ba ni legs bshad du grags mod/ lam 'og ma dang phar phyin theg pa'i spang bya gzhan la yang mtshungs shing phar phyin theg pa'i ring lam la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor med la lam gzhan rnams yod pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa dang*/ de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog/ sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /zhes sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' mchog gnyis ka sngags la 'jug par gsungs pa sogs dang*/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ khyad par mtshan brjod kyi/ grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /zhes grol ba dang thar pa dang lus rnam grol zhes bya bar gnas pa'i tha ma ni sngags kyi rnam grol du shin tu gsal te/ dus 'khor du/ des na gtso bos gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg par bstan/ /ces phar phyin theg pa la rtogs bya'i stong nyid rdzogs par sgom pa yod kyang*/

/yun can 'gyur med bde ba dang bral ba des na zhes sbyar nas gsal bar gsungs shing*/ gtso bor lus la gnad du bsnun pa yod med kyis mdo sngags dang rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad par 'jog par grags shing grub pa'i phyir/ mtshan brjod las/ nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing*/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can ni phar phyin theg pa'i gdul bya yin la/ sgrib pa de gnyis las grol ba zhig gis da dung*/ bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes pas phar phyin theg pa'i sgos kyi mthar thug gi rnam grol las lhag pa'i 'bras bu'am spangs pa'i myang 'das shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dngos dang rtsod spang ngo*/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi rjod byed ni bsdu na gnyis te/ sangs rgyas gzhan dang thun mong ba mdo phyogs sde snod gsum dang*/ shāka thub kyi thun mong min pa sngags phyogs rgyud sde bzhi'o/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ kha cig gzungs sngags yod med la byed mod/ 'dul ba sman gyi gzhi sogs du ma rgyud du 'gyur ro/ kha cig dkyil 'khor yod med la byed pa ni/ sman bla'i mdo yang rgyud du 'gyur la/ rin chen las grub grub bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ / zhes gnas brtan phyag mchod kyang rgyud kyi cho gar 'gyur ro/ /des na sngags dang dkyil 'khor khyad med du yod kyang*/ sgrub pa po la chos smra ba nges zhes dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa des zhes sogs kyis 'byed ces mkhas pa dag gsung ba'ang khas blang du rung tsam mo/ /sdom gsum rab dbyer/ mdo dang rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ /bya ba'i cho ga yod med yin/ /zhes pa la gzhan dag gi bshad pa rnams kyis ni khyad par 'byed nus pa mi snang mod/ bya ba'i cho ga khyad par ba/ sngags dang*/ sngags don bde stong phra rags dang sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang*/ de dang de'i lag pa'i phyag rgya thun mong min pa rnams sbyar rgyu yod pa'i cho ga dang ldan na rgyud dang*/

mi ldan na mdo sde yin no zhes pa ni/ /rje btsun gong ma nas brgyud pa'i chos rje sa paṇa gyi bzhed par gsal lo/ /bla ma snga mas lam bde bas brgyan ma brgyan la rgyud sde dang mdo sde mdzad pa ni/ bde ba'i thugs rtse gtad sa khyad par ba med na ni/ tshig gi brjod tshul rtsings pas/ bla ma phyi ma dag gis bsam gtan gyi bde ba sogs kyis ma nges gsung ba med do/ khyad par ba yod du chug kyang*/ rgyan zhes pas rgyan sa'am lam gyi ngo bo gzhan zhig yod par khas blangs pas kyang 'thad pa ma yin te/ bde ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gtso bo'i ngo bo yin gyi gos dang rgyan tsam ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mdo phyogs la thabs shes gcig la gcig gis/ rtsis zin pa tsam la dbyer med byed dgos shing de la rdo rje'i don mi tshang bas sngags la ni/ tshor ba bde ba la/ sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pas/ /snying rje'o zhes pa'i don rdzogs par tshang zhing*/ blo de nyid stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi ngo bor skyed cing legs par goms pa nyid lam gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ spyir tshor ba dang sgos lus/ sems gnyis su phye ba'i lus tshor gyis stong nyid mngon sum du byed pa lam gyi gtso bor yod pa sngags dang med pa mdo yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya bod mang po rnams mgrin gcig tu sngags la'ang sogs te/ sngags kyi nang na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi cha dam tshig dang sdom pa sogs ston pa rnams 'dul ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom rim ston pa rnams mdo sde dang*/ shes rab khyad par can ston pa rnams mngon pa yin pas sde snod gsum nyid du 'dus pa'i phyir zur pa min no zhe na/ /rig pa sogs sde snod bzhi par sa paṇa sogs kyi rgya bod mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa ltar 'thad de/ dpal ldan gsang ba sogs snod dang rtsa ba mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i khyad par phye nas ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud dang sgron gsal du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa la/ mdo dang*/ sngags so/ dang po la sde snod gsum ni 'dul ba sogs te/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang sems dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum po dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor mdzad pa'o/ /de rnams kyi mtshan gzhi la 'dul ba ni/ lung sde bzhi yin te/ lung gzhi dang*/ rnam 'byed dang*/ phran tshegs dang*/ gzhung dam pa zhes bya ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po gnyis la glegs bam po ti bzhi bzhi las/ gzhi la bcu bdun te/ rab byung gso sbyong gzhi dang ni/ /dgag dbye dbyar dang ko lpags dang*| |sman dang gos dang sra brkyang dang*/ /ko shaṃ bi dang las kyi gzhi/ /dmar ser can dang gang zag dang*/ /spo dang gso sbyong bzhag pa dang*/ /gnas mal dang ni rtsod pa dang*/ /dge 'dun dbyen rnams bsdus pa yin/ /zhes lung las khrag khrugs su gsungs pa/ slob dpon gyi nyams su blang bde bar go rim snol nas sbyar te gsungs so/ /rnam 'byed la pha ma'i rnam 'byed gnyis ka la ltung ba sde lnga lngar phye nas phal cher gleng gzhi dang bcas te gsungs so/ /phran tshegs la yang ltung ba sde lnga'i ma tshang kha skong mang du gsungs shing*/ lung dam pa la ni/ zhu ba dang*/ 'dul byed dang*/ gleng gzhi dang*/ gtam gyi gzhi dang*/ sil bu dang*/ bram ze'i bu mos zhus pa sogs gzhung phran bcu tsam gsungs so/ /mdo sde'i sde snod kyi theg chung ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag snga 'gyur po ti gsum lhag dang*/ phyi 'gyur yang de tsam mo/ gzhan yang theg chung gi mdo mang phran tshegs mang po ni sogs so/ /mdo mang theg chen sogs 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po sogs sher phyin dang brjod bya gcig pa du ma bzhugs so/ /mngon pa'i sde snod theg chung ni/ ye shes la 'jug ka tya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig shes kyis| |chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mau gal bus| |rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/

/'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /zhes pa rnams mdo sde pa ni dgra bcom pa de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos su 'dod la/ bye smra ni/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bzhin du dgra bcom pa de dag gis bsdus pa tsam yin gyis mdo yin no zhes smra'o/ /theg chen mngon pa'i sde snod stong phrag brgya pa zhig dga' ldan na bzhugs shing gzhan 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa rnams la ni/ gaṇḍe'i sgra la brtags nas mu stegs kyi dmag dang*/ yul dbus kyi rgyal po'i skyes kyi gos la snying ga na rkang rjes lta bu'i ri mo yod pa la brtags nas mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po'i dmag gis bcom pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi sprang po la khrus chu gtor bas khros nas nyi ma bsgrubs te gtsug lag khang thams cad bsregs pa ste dgra lan gsum byung bas brlag par grags so/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde ni/ sde lnga dang bdun du 'byed pa sogs du ma yod kyang*| grags che zhing mthun snang du grub pa ni/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de dag la/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni sems can mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de dag la'o/ /zhes gdul bya la dman pa dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen po dang*/ chen po'i chen po ste bzhir nges pa de dag 'dul byed kyi rgyud la'ang bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bzhi'o/ /bla med la yang pha ma gnyis su nges par phyis kyi mkhas pas bsgrubs shing*/ de dang mi mthun pa dag gis kyang legs so byas mod kyi/ bla med kyi dbang la gsum dang*/ de'i lam yang rigs gsum dang*/ 'bras bu yang gsum du 'byed bzhin du rjaud byed la gsum du mi 'byed pa mi rigs la/ pha ma gnyis ka gnyis med yin pas de gnyis las don gzhan pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud med pas dus kyi 'khor lor yang ma rgyud nyid do zhes bsgrags shing rjes 'brang shin tu mang pos kyang rjes su brjod pa la ni/

dbang bzhi pa de dang po gnyis su 'dus pas zur du bzhag rgyu med do zhes sogs brjod pa la gzur gnas blo ldan byed na lan med do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'di dag gzhung tshad sogs te/ gzhan rgyud sde kun shes sogs su rgya cher bshad pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ste/ /de yi gzhi ni rig pa'i gnas lnga yin/ /de dag rgya cher so sor brjod zin kyang*/ /byung tshul rang bzhin mdor bsdus 'dod rnams la/ /phan gdags bya phyir rtsa 'grel mdo tsam byas/ /'di yis mig phye rgyas bshad gzugs rnams la/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dga' ston cher myong nas/ /kun mkhyen lam la 'gro kun 'jug par shog

/ces rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba/ gtsang stag tshang gi dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ gser 'phyang zhes bya ba me mo bya'i sa ga zla ba'i snga tshes nyi shu gcig la/ lo chen chos ky-i rgyal po a ti sha'i zla mchod dang*/ phyi tshes nyi shu sngon gyi 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i zla mchod la sbyar ba dge'o/ / swasti/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po stag tshang ba'i*/ /zhabs pad dri med mchog la rab btud nas/ /gang des mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes kyi/ /rtsa 'grel phul byung spar du grub tshul ni/ /rje de'i bya ba las kyi kha lo ba/ /nye gnas chen po lha yi dpal bzang kyis/ /bdag rkyen bgyis nas bris la rab mkhas pa/ /tshul khrims 'phel gyis legs par bris pa la/ /dge slong grub pa rgyal mtshan brda sprod pas/ /zhus dag byas shing brkos la rab mkhas pa/ /chos kyi bzang pos khro mo zhes bya ba/ /shing pho 'brug lo gro zhun gyis nya'i nyin/ /dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du spar du grub/ /grub 'di'i spar shing pho brang rtse nas phul| |phul byung 'thun rkyen bla brang shar nas sbyar/ /sbyar ba'i dge ba rta ljang dbang po des/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i ma rig mun bcom nas/ /rig gnas pad dkar skyed tshal rab brgyas ste/ /bstan 'dzin bung ba sbrang rtsis tshim pa dang| |stag tshang lo tsā'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog/ //ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tu nteṣānta thā ga to hya wang ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ //maṃ ga laṃ bha wantu// shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga'/ -PAGE 92--PAGE 91-- PAGE 22-
